## [PART 11]{.HLabel1}[Special Voting Rules]{.HTitleText1} {#h-205333 .Part}

### [Interpretation and Application]{.HTitleText2} {#h-205334 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[177]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-177 .sectionLabel}** The definitions in this
section apply in this Part, and Parts 11.1 and 19.

[[administrative centre]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[administrative centre]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, 2018, c.
    31, s. 124\]]{.Repealed}

[[application for registration and special ballot]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[application for registration and special
    ballot]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an application completed by an
    elector in order to vote under this Part. ([demande d'inscription et
    de bulletin de vote spécial]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[Canadian Forces elector]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Canadian Forces elector]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, 2018, c.
    31, s. 124\]]{.Repealed}

[[commanding officer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[commanding officer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the commanding
    officer of a unit. ([commandant]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[coordinating officer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[coordinating officer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the person so
    designated by the Minister of National Defence under subsection
    199(1) or a person so designated by the minister responsible for
    corrections in a province under section 246. ([agent
    coordonnateur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[deputy returning officer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[deputy returning officer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
    2018, c. 31, s. 124\]]{.Repealed}

[[incarcerated elector]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[incarcerated elector]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an elector who is
    incarcerated in a correctional institution. ([électeur
    incarcéré]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[inner envelope]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[inner envelope]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an envelope, including
    one that is supplied by the Chief Electoral Officer, in which a
    ballot or special ballot is to be enclosed after it has been
    marked. ([enveloppe intérieure]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[liaison officer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[liaison officer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an elector designated
    as a liaison officer under subsection 199.2(1) or a person appointed
    as a liaison officer under subsection 248(1). ([agent de
    liaison]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[outer envelope]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[outer envelope]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an envelope, including
    one that is supplied by the Chief Electoral Officer, in which a
    ballot or special ballot is to be transmitted after it has been
    marked and enclosed in an inner envelope. ([enveloppe
    extérieure]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[special ballot]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[special ballot]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a ballot, other than a
    ballot referred to in section 241, that is provided to an elector
    who is entitled to vote under this Part. ([bulletin de vote
    spécial]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[special ballot officer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[special ballot officer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person who is
    appointed by the Chief Electoral Officer under section 183 or
    184. ([agent des bulletins de vote spéciaux]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[special voting rules administrator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[special voting rules administrator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    person who is appointed under section 181. ([administrateur des
    règles électorales spéciales]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[statement of ordinary residence]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[statement of ordinary residence]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
    2018, c. 31, s. 124\]]{.Repealed}

[[unit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[unit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as in subsection
    2(1) of the [National Defence Act](/eng/acts/N-5) and includes a
    base or other element. ([unité]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[unit election officer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[unit election officer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an elector
    designated as a unit election officer under paragraph
    205(1)(b). ([fonctionnaire électoral d'unité]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[voting territory]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[voting territory]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, 2018, c. 31, s.
    124\]]{.Repealed}

:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application

- **[[178]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-178 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  voting procedures contained in this Part apply to general elections
  only.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer may, by instructions,
  adapt this Part so that any or all of its provisions apply to a
  by-election.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Instructions

**[[179]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-179 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
applying this Part to, or adapting any provision of this Part in respect
of, a particular circumstance, the Chief Electoral Officer may issue any
instructions that he or she considers necessary in order to execute its
intent.

### [DIVISION 1]{.HLabel2}[Administration and General Procedures]{.HTitleText2} {#h-205360 .Subheading}

**[[180]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-180 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed, 2018, c.
31, s. 125\]]{.Repealed}

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-180-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 180"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Appointment of special voting rules
administrator

**[[181]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-181 .sectionLabel}** The Chief Electoral
Officer shall appoint, in the prescribed form, a special voting rules
administrator.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duties of special voting rules
administrator

**[[182]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-182 .sectionLabel}** The special voting
rules administrator shall

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} secure suitable premises;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} retain the solemn declaration of each special ballot
  officer that is made under subsection 23(1);

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} obtain from the liaison officers the lists prepared
  under paragraph 204(1)(b);

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} obtain from the liaison officers the lists of the
  names of unit election officers that the commanding officers are
  required to provide;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} distribute the election materials and the list of
  candidates;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} receive, validate, examine and sort the completed
  outer envelopes that contain special ballots marked by electors;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} proceed with the counting of the votes of electors;
  and

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} communicate the results of the votes cast in
  accordance with this Part.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 182
- [2018, c. 31, s. 126](#1042114-1131836){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042114-1131836.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-182-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 182"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Special ballot officers

- **[[183]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-183
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} After the issue of the writs, the
  Chief Electoral Officer shall appoint a minimum of six special ballot
  officers as follows:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} three, on the recommendation of the Prime Minister
    or a person whom the Prime Minister designates in writing;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} two, on the recommendation of the Leader of the
    Opposition or a person whom that Leader designates in writing; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} one, on the recommendation of the Leader of the
    registered party that has the third largest number of members in the
    House of Commons as of the last general election, or a person whom
    that Leader designates in writing.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Appointment of special ballot officers

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A special ballot officer shall be appointed in the
  prescribed form.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Appointment of additional special ballot
officers

- **[[184]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-184 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If
  the Chief Electoral Officer is of the opinion that the number of
  special ballot officers appointed under section 183 is insufficient,
  the Chief Electoral Officer shall appoint additional special ballot
  officers on recommendations that are, as nearly as possible, in
  accordance with subsection 183(1).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Decision of Chief Electoral Officer

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the registered parties do not nominate the
  additional special ballot officers under subsection (1) within 24
  hours after notification by the Chief Electoral Officer, the Chief
  Electoral Officer shall make the appointments from among individuals
  that he or she selects.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Merger of parties

- **[[185]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-185 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In
  the case of a merger of two or more of the registered parties that are
  represented by the Prime Minister, the Leader of the Opposition or the
  Leader of the registered party that has the third largest number of
  members in the House of Commons as of the last general election, the
  person who may recommend special ballot officers under paragraph
  183(1)(c) is the leader of the registered party with the largest
  number of members in the House of Commons as of the last general
  election among registered parties other than those three.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Decision of Chief Electoral Officer

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} In the case of a merger referred to in subsection
  (1), if there is no registered party whose leader may nominate special
  ballot officers under paragraph 183(1)(c), the Chief Electoral Officer
  shall make the appointments from among individuals that he or she
  considers appropriate.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Form of special ballots

**[[186]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-186 .sectionLabel}** Special ballots
supplied by the Chief Electoral Officer to electors under this Part
shall be in accordance with Form 4 of Schedule 1.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Distribution of election materials

**[[186.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-186.1 .sectionLabel}** Without delay after
the writs are issued, the special voting rules administrator shall
distribute to commanding officers and, as the special voting rules
administrator considers appropriate, to any other person or to any place
the election materials necessary to carry out the purposes and
provisions of this Part, including materials for the purpose of
determining in which electoral district an elector is entitled to vote.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 31, s. 127](#1042119-1111320){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042119-1111320.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}List of candidates

**[[187]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-187 .sectionLabel}** The Chief Electoral
Officer shall establish a list of candidates nominated in each electoral
district and, in accordance with section 117, set out the political
affiliation of each of them.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Delivery of list of candidates

**[[188]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-188 .sectionLabel}** Without delay after a
list of candidates is established, the special voting rules
administrator shall provide the list to the coordinating officer, to
every liaison officer and commanding officer and, as the special voting
rules administrator considers appropriate, to any other person.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 188
- [2018, c. 31, s. 128](#1042121-1111325){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042121-1111325.html"}
:::

### [DIVISION 2]{.HLabel2}[Canadian Forces Electors]{.HTitleText2} {#h-205403 .Subheading}

#### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText3} {#h-205404 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[190]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-190 .sectionLabel}** The definitions in this
section apply in this Division.

[[alternative address]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[alternative address]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the address of the
    office of the returning officer for the electoral district of the
    elector's place of ordinary residence. ([adresse de
    substitution]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[elector]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[elector]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person referred to in
    section 191. ([électeur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[service number]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[service number]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a unique identifier
    assigned by the Canadian Forces under the [National Defence
    Act](/eng/acts/N-5) to each member of the Canadian Forces. ([numéro
    matricule]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[voting period]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[voting period]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the period beginning 14
    days before polling day and ending 9 days before polling
    day. ([période de scrutin]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 190
- [2018, c. 31, s. 130](#1042130-1131842){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042130-1131842.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-190-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 190"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Election officers

**[[190.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-190.1 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
section 9, subsections 23(1) and (2) and section 23.1, the coordinating
officer, liaison officers designated under subsection 199.2(1),
commanding officers and unit election officers are deemed to be election
officers and paragraph 43(c), subsection 484(1) and paragraph 484(3)(f)
also apply to them if they are relieved of duty.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 31, s. 131](#1042135-1131846){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042135-1131846.html"}
:::

#### [Voting Entitlement]{.HTitleText3} {#h-205409 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Qualification and right to vote

**[[191]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-191 .sectionLabel}** Any of the following
persons is entitled to vote under this Division if he or she is
qualified as an elector under section 3:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a member of the regular force of the Canadian Forces;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a member of the reserve force of the Canadian Forces;
  and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} a member of the special force of the Canadian Forces.

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2018, c. 31, s. 133\]]{.Repealed}

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 191
- [2018, c. 31, s. 133](#1042145-1131855){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042145-1131855.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-191-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 191"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Registration]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1131856 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Right to register

- **[[192]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-192 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} When
  a person becomes entitled to vote under this Division, the person's
  commanding officer shall inform him or her of the right to ask the
  Chief Electoral Officer to include him or her in the Register of
  Electors or, if already included in it, to ask for his or her
  registration to be updated.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Right to register --- future elector

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} When a future elector is enrolled in the Canadian
  Forces, or when a member of the Canadian Forces becomes qualified as a
  future elector, the future elector's commanding officer shall inform
  him or her of the right to ask the Chief Electoral Officer to include
  him or her in the Register of Future Electors or, if already included
  in it, to ask for his or her registration to be updated.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Service number

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} An elector, or a future elector who is a member of
  the Canadian Forces, who asks the Chief Electoral Officer to include
  him or her in the Register of Electors or Register of Future Electors,
  or asks for his or her registration to be updated, must provide his or
  her service number to the Chief Electoral Officer.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 192
- [2018, c. 31, s. 134](#1042151-1131866){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042151-1131866.html"}
:::

#### [Coordinating Officer]{.HTitleText3} {#h-205490 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Designation

- **[[199]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-199 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  Minister of National Defence shall designate a person as a
  coordinating officer to work, during and between elections, with the
  Chief Electoral Officer in carrying out the purposes and provisions of
  this Division.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duty

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The coordinating officer shall, on request, provide
  to the Chief Electoral Officer the following information relating to
  each elector or future elector:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} his or her surname, given names, gender, rank and
    service number;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} his or her date of birth;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the civic address and mailing address of his or her
    place of ordinary residence; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} his or her current mailing address.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Updating Register of Electors

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer may use the information
  provided under subsection (2) to update the Register of Electors or
  Register of Future Electors.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Retention of certain information

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer may retain the
  information provided under subsection (2), but not included in the
  Register of Electors or Register of Future Electors, for the purpose
  of correlating information subsequently collected with information
  already contained in the relevant register.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information provided to coordinating
  officer

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer may provide the
  coordinating officer with the information referred to in paragraphs
  (2)(a) to (d) relating to each elector or future elector who has
  provided a service number under this Part.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 199
- [2018, c. 31, s. 135](#1042155-1131888){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042155-1131888.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-199-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 199"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Cooperation

**[[199.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-199.1 .sectionLabel}** The coordinating
officer shall cooperate with the special voting rules administrator to
facilitate the voting, under Divisions 3 and 4 of this Part, of

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a person employed by or in support of the Canadian
  Forces outside Canada;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a person who accompanies a unit or other element of
  the Canadian Forces that is on service or active service outside
  Canada, within the meaning of subsection 61(1) of the [National
  Defence Act](/eng/acts/N-5); or

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} a person who resides outside Canada with a member of
  the Canadian Forces or with a person referred to in paragraph (a) or
  (b).

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 31, s. 136](#1042157-1131895){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042157-1131895.html"}
:::

#### [Liaison Officers]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1121011 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Designation

- **[[199.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-199.2
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister of National Defence
  shall designate one or more electors as liaison officers to work,
  during and between election periods, with the Chief Electoral Officer
  and the coordinating officer in carrying out the purposes and
  provisions of this Division.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duty of coordinating officer

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The coordinating officer shall provide the Chief
  Electoral Officer with the name and address of each liaison officer as
  each one is designated.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 31, s. 136](#1042157-1121018){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042157-1121018.html"}
:::

#### [Steps to Prepare for Vote]{.HTitleText3} {#h-205500 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duty of Chief Electoral Officer

**[[200]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-200 .sectionLabel}** Without delay after the
issue of the writs, the Chief Electoral Officer shall inform the
Minister of National Defence and the coordinating officer of their
issue.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 200
- [2018, c. 31, s. 137](#1042159-1121023){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042159-1121023.html"}
:::

Version](section-200-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 200"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[201]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-201 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed, 2018, c.
31, s. 137\]]{.Repealed}

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-201-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 201"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duty of coordinating officer

**[[202]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202 .sectionLabel}** On being informed of
the issue of the writs, the coordinating officer shall inform each
liaison officer and commanding officer of their issue.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 202
- [2018, c. 31, s. 137](#1042159-1121029){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042159-1121029.html"}
:::

[Previous
Version](section-202-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 202"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duty of liaison officers --- information

**[[203]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-203 .sectionLabel}** On being informed of
the issue of the writs, a liaison officer shall give each commanding
officer in respect of whose unit the liaison officer has liaison duties
all necessary information for carrying out the purposes and provisions
of this Division.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 203
- [2018, c. 31, s. 137](#1042159-1121034){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042159-1121034.html"}
:::

[Previous
Version](section-203-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 203"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Duties of Commanding Officers]{.HTitleText3} {#h-205514 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice

- **[[204]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-204 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} On
  being informed of the issue of the writs, each commanding officer
  shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} publish a notice as a part of unit orders; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} prepare a list of the names of the electors of his
    or her unit.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Contents of notice

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The notice shall notify electors that an election has
  been called and of the date of polling day and shall inform the
  electors that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} they may vote in accordance with this Division; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the commanding officer will designate one or more
    unit election officers to collect their votes and fix the voting
    times during the voting period.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Contents of list

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The list shall be arranged alphabetically and shall
  indicate each elector's surname, given names and service number, the
  address of his or her place of ordinary residence and his or her
  electoral district.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 204
- [2018, c. 31, s. 138](#1042166-1131901){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042166-1131901.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-204-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 204"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Alternative address --- commanding
officer

- **[[204.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-204.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of maintaining
  operational security, a commanding officer may indicate on the list of
  electors, with respect to some or all of the electors in the
  commanding officer's unit, their alternative address rather than the
  address that would otherwise be indicated under subsection 204(3).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Alternative address --- elector

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of maintaining operational security
  or out of a reasonable apprehension of bodily harm if the address of
  his or her place of ordinary residence were to appear on the list of
  electors, an elector may ask his or her commanding officer not to
  indicate that address on the list of electors. The commanding officer,
  unless he or she considers that it would not be in the public interest
  to do so, shall grant the request and indicate the elector's
  alternative address on the list.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Special voting rules administrator
  informed

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The commanding officer shall inform the special
  voting rules administrator, through a liaison officer, that an
  alternative address has been indicated under this section.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Clarification

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} For greater certainty, the indication of an
  alternative address on the list of electors under this section does
  not change the elector's place of ordinary residence for the purposes
  of this Act.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 31, s. 139](#1042171-1131912){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042171-1131912.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duties of commanding officer

- **[[205]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-205
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} After being informed of the issue of
  the writs, but no later than the 28th day before polling day, each
  commanding officer shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} establish polling stations;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} designate a sufficient number of electors as unit
    election officers to allow for voting to take place at each polling
    station;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} through a liaison officer, provide the special
    voting rules administrator with a list of the unit election officers
    and their ranks, and the list of electors for the unit; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} provide the unit election officers with the list of
    electors for the unit.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Facilities

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Each commanding officer shall provide the facilities
  that are necessary to enable the electors to vote in accordance with
  this Division.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Voting times

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Each commanding officer shall fix the voting times so
  that the polling stations in his or her unit are open for at least
  three hours a day on at least three days during the voting period.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 205
- [2018, c. 31, s. 140](#1042178-1131919){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042178-1131919.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-205-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 205"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Mobile polling station

- **[[206]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-206 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  commanding officer may establish a mobile polling station in any area
  for the purpose of collecting the votes of electors who cannot
  conveniently reach polling stations established at their unit.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Opening period

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A mobile polling station shall remain in an area and
  be open for the collection of votes for the days and hours during the
  voting period that the commanding officer considers necessary to give
  electors in the area a reasonable opportunity to vote.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Joint polling stations

**[[207]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-207 .sectionLabel}** The commanding officers
of units may establish a joint polling station for electors in their
units, if the commanding officers consider that it would be useful to do
so for carrying out the purposes and provisions of this Division.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 207
- [2018, c. 31, s. 141](#1042183-1131924){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042183-1131924.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-207-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 207"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of polling stations and voting
times

**[[208]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-208 .sectionLabel}** During each of three or
more days before the voting period and on each day on which the vote is
held, each commanding officer shall publish in his or her unit's orders
and put in a conspicuous place a notice that states

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the days on which the electors may vote;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the precise location of, and the voting hours at,
  each polling station, other than a mobile polling station; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a mobile polling station, its location
  and the anticipated period during which it is to remain at that
  location.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Election materials

**[[209]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-209 .sectionLabel}** On receiving election
materials and the list of candidates, each commanding officer shall

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} distribute the materials to the unit election
  officers; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} display the list in one or more conspicuous places or
  make it otherwise accessible to electors in their unit.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 209
- [2018, c. 31, s. 142](#1042185-1131929){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042185-1131929.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-209-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 209"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Voting]{.HTitleText3} {#h-205555 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duties of unit election officer

**[[210]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-210 .sectionLabel}** During the voting
period, a unit election officer shall

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} display the voting instructions provided by the Chief
  Electoral Officer in relation to the vote under this Division in
  conspicuous places at each polling station or make them otherwise
  accessible to electors; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} keep available for consultation by the electors the
  text of this Part, the election materials necessary for determining in
  which electoral district an elector is entitled to vote and the list
  of candidates.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 210
- [2018, c. 31, s. 143](#1042187-1131936){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042187-1131936.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-210-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 210"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Representative of registered party

**[[211]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-211 .sectionLabel}** A Canadian citizen may
represent a registered party at a polling station if he or she provides
the unit election officer with a copy of an authorization in the
prescribed form signed by a candidate for the party.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 211
- [2018, c. 31, s. 143](#1042187-1131941){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042187-1131941.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-211-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 211"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Elector to give name, etc.

- **[[211.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-211.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Each elector, on arriving at the
  polling station, shall give his or her name and service number and the
  address of his or her place of ordinary residence to the unit election
  officer and, on request, to a representative of a registered party.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Alternative address

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of subsection (1), if an alternative
  address is indicated on the list of electors under section 204.1 in
  respect of the elector, the elector may provide that alternative
  address.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Proof of identity

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If the unit election officer determines that the
  elector's name, service number and address appear on the list of
  electors, then the elector shall provide the officer with the
  following proof of the elector's identity:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} one piece of identification issued by the Canadian
    Forces that contains a photograph of the elector and his or her name
    and service number; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} two pieces of identification of a type authorized
    under section 211.3 each of which establishes the elector's name and
    at least one of which establishes his or her service number.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Examination of identification documents

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} A representative of a registered party may examine,
  but not handle, any piece of identification presented under this
  section.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Name crossed off the list

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} If the unit election officer is satisfied that an
  elector's identity has been proven in accordance with this section,
  the elector's name shall be crossed off the list of electors.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 31, s. 143](#1042187-1131956){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042187-1131956.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application for registration and special
ballot

- **[[211.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-211.2
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An elector whose name does not
  appear on the list of electors or whose address on the list does not
  correspond with the elector's place of ordinary residence may complete
  an application for registration and special ballot and provide the
  unit election officer with the following proof of the elector's
  identity:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} one piece of identification issued by the Canadian
    Forces that contains a photograph of the elector and his or her name
    and service number; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} two pieces of identification of a type authorized
    under section 211.3 each of which establishes the elector's name and
    at least one of which establishes his or her service number.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Content of application

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An application for registration and special ballot
  shall be in the prescribed form and shall include the following
  information relating to each elector:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} his or her surname and given names;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} his or her date of birth;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} his or her service number;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the civic address and mailing address of his or her
    place of ordinary residence;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} his or her current mailing address; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} any other information that the Chief Electoral
    Officer considers necessary to determine the electoral district in
    which he or she is entitled to vote.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Alternative addresses

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of maintaining operational security
  or out of a reasonable apprehension of bodily harm if he or she were
  to indicate the addresses referred to in paragraph 2(d), the elector
  may apply to the elector's commanding officer to use another address
  for that purpose. The commanding officer, unless he or she considers
  that it would not be in the public interest to do so, shall grant the
  application and provide the elector with the alternative address that
  is to be used on the application for registration and special ballot.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Optional information

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} In addition to the information specified in
  subsection (2), the Chief Electoral Officer may request that the
  elector provide other information that the Chief Electoral Officer
  considers necessary for implementing agreements made under section 55,
  but the elector is not required to provide that information.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Examination of identification documents

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} A representative of a registered party may examine,
  but not handle, any piece of identification presented under this
  section.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Acceptance of the application

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} If the unit election officer is satisfied that an
  elector's identity has been proven in accordance with this section,
  the unit election officer shall accept the application for
  registration and special ballot.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application of subsections 204.1(3) and
  (4)

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} If an alternative address is used in accordance with
  subsection (3), subsections 204.1(3) and (4) apply with any necessary
  modifications.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 31, s. 143](#1042187-1131981){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042187-1131981.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Authorized types of identification

**[[211.3]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-211.3 .sectionLabel}** The Chief Electoral
Officer may authorize types of identification, in consultation with the
coordinating officer, for the purposes of paragraphs 211.1(3)(b) and
211.2(1)(b). For greater certainty, any document may be authorized,
regardless of who issued it.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 31, s. 143](#1042187-1131985){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042187-1131985.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Declaration of elector

**[[212]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-212 .sectionLabel}** The unit election
officer shall require the elector whose name has been crossed off the
list of electors or whose application for registration and special
ballot has been accepted to sign the declaration prescribed by the Chief
Electoral Officer.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 212
- [2018, c. 31, s. 143](#1042187-1131990){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042187-1131990.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-212-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 212"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Provision of special ballot, etc.

- **[[213]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-213 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  unit election officer shall, once the elector has signed the
  declaration referred to in section 212, give the elector a special
  ballot, an inner envelope, the declaration --- if it is not on the
  outer envelope --- and the outer envelope.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limitation

  [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} An elector who has received a special ballot under
  subsection (1) may vote only under this Division.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Voting on special ballot

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The elector shall use the special ballot to vote by
  writing on it, in private, the name of the candidate of his or her
  choice, folding it and, in the presence of the unit election officer,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} placing the folded special ballot in the inner
    envelope and sealing the envelope; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} placing the inner envelope and the declaration ---
    if it is not on the outer envelope --- in the outer envelope and
    sealing the outer envelope.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Writing candidate's name

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The candidate shall be indicated on a special ballot
  by writing the candidate's given name or initials and surname. If two
  or more candidates have the same name, their political affiliations
  shall be indicated.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Spoiled special ballot

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} If the special ballot is incapable of being used, the
  elector shall return it to the unit election officer, who shall mark
  it as a spoiled ballot and give the elector another special ballot.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} An elector shall not be given more than one special
  ballot under subsection (4).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 213
- [2018, c. 31, s. 144](#1042198-1132000){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042198-1132000.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-213-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 213"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information to be provided to elector

- **[[214]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-214 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  unit election officer shall inform an elector that, in order for the
  special ballot to be counted, the outer envelope must be received by
  the special voting rules administrator in the National Capital Region
  no later than 6:00 p.m. on polling day. The unit election officer
  shall inform the elector of the service provided by the Canadian
  Forces to deliver the outer envelope.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Sending the outer envelope

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the elector does not use the delivery service
  provided by the Canadian Forces, it is the elector's responsibility to
  ensure that the outer envelope is sent to the special voting rules
  administrator.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2018, c. 31, s. 145\]]{.Repealed}

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 214
- [2018, c. 31, s. 145](#1042211-1132006){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042211-1132006.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-214-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 214"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Voting by unit election officer

**[[215]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-215 .sectionLabel}** A unit election officer
who is qualified to vote may vote in accordance with this Division.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 215
- [2018, c. 31, s. 146](#1042215-1132011){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042215-1132011.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-215-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 215"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Assistance by unit election officer

- **[[216]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-216 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If
  an elector is unable to read or because of a disability is unable to
  vote in the manner described in this Division, the unit election
  officer shall assist him or her by

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} completing the declaration referred to in section
    212 and writing the elector's name where the elector's signature is
    to be written; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} marking the special ballot as directed by the
    elector in the elector's presence and in the presence of another
    elector selected by the elector as a witness.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Note and keeping vote secret

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The unit election officer and an elector acting as a
  witness shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} sign a note on the declaration indicating that the
    elector was assisted; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} keep secret the name of the candidate for whom the
    elector voted.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 216
- [2018, c. 31, s. 147](#1042224-1132020){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042224-1132020.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-216-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 216"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Hospitalized or convalescing elector

- **[[217]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-217 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  elector who is a patient in a service hospital or convalescent
  institution during the voting times fixed for the polling stations in
  his or her unit is deemed to be a member of the unit under the command
  of the officer in charge of the hospital or institution.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Unit election officer for hospitalized
  electors

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If no unit election officer has been designated for a
  service hospital or convalescent institution, the unit election
  officer for the unit to which the hospital or institution belongs is
  the unit election officer for electors who are patients in the
  hospital or institution.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Bed-ridden electors

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A unit election officer for electors who are patients
  in a service hospital or convalescent institution may, if that officer
  considers it advisable and the officer in charge of the hospital or
  institution approves, go from room to room to administer and collect
  the votes of electors who are confined to bed.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 217
- [2018, c. 31, s. 148](#1042231-1132027){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042231-1132027.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-217-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 217"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duty, leave or furlough

**[[218]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-218 .sectionLabel}** An elector who provides
satisfactory evidence of his or her absence from his or her unit during
the voting times fixed for the polling stations in that unit because of
duty, leave or furlough may apply to a unit election officer of another
unit, in accordance with section 211.2, to vote at that officer's
polling station.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 218
- [2018, c. 31, s. 149](#1042233-1132032){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042233-1132032.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-218-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 218"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Delivery of documents to the commanding
officer

- **[[219]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-219 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  unit election officer shall deliver to the unit's commanding officer,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} at the end of each voting day, if feasible, and no
    later than the end of the voting period, the outer envelopes
    containing the marked special ballots, the applications for
    registration and special ballot that were accepted by the unit
    election officer and the service number of each elector who received
    a special ballot; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} at the end of the voting period, any spoiled outer
    envelopes, any spoiled special ballots and any other election
    documents and election materials in the unit election officer's
    possession.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Delivery of outer envelopes, etc.

  [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} On receipt of the outer envelopes and applications
  for registration and special ballot referred to in paragraph (1)(a),
  the commanding officer shall deliver them to the special voting rules
  administrator.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Provision of information

  [(1.2)]{.lawlabel} On receipt of the service numbers referred to in
  paragraph (1)(a), the commanding officer shall inform the special
  voting rules administrator, through the liaison officer, of the
  identity of the electors who received a special ballot.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Delivery of election documents and
  election materials

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} On receipt of the election documents and election
  materials referred to in paragraph (1)(b), the commanding officer
  shall deliver them to the special voting rules administrator with all
  other election documents and election materials in the commanding
  officer's possession.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 219
- [2018, c. 31, s. 149](#1042233-1132046){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042233-1132046.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-219-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 219"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Informing the returning officer

- **[[219.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-219.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} On being informed under subsection
  219(1.2) that an elector has received a special ballot, the special
  voting rules administrator shall inform the returning officer for the
  electoral district of the elector's place of ordinary residence of
  this.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Name on list of electors

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} When the returning officer is informed under
  subsection (1) that an elector has received a special ballot, he or
  she shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if the elector's name is not already included on a
    list of electors, enter the elector's name on the list of electors
    for the appropriate polling division in that electoral district; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} indicate on the list of electors that the elector
    has received a special ballot.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 31, s. 149](#1042233-1132055){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042233-1132055.html"}
:::

### [DIVISION 3]{.HLabel2}[Electors Resident Outside Canada]{.HTitleText2} {#h-205615 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[220]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-220 .sectionLabel}** The definitions in this
section apply in this Division.

[[elector]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[elector]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an elector who resides outside
    Canada. ([électeur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[register]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[register]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the register referred to in
    section 222. ([registre]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 220
- [2018, c. 31, s. 151](#1042237-1130803){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042237-1130803.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-220-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 220"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Inclusion in register of electors
resident outside Canada

**[[221]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-221 .sectionLabel}** An elector may vote
under this Division if

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} his or her application for registration and special
  ballot is received by the special voting rules administrator in the
  National Capital Region no later than 6:00 p.m. on the 6th day before
  polling day; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} his or her name is entered on the register.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 221
- [2018, c. 31, s. 152](#1042239-1130810){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042239-1130810.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-221-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 221"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Register of electors

**[[222]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-222 .sectionLabel}** The Chief Electoral
Officer shall maintain a register of electors in which is entered the
surname, given names, gender, date of birth, civic address, mailing
address and electoral district of each elector who has filed an
application for registration and special ballot in order to vote under
this Division and who, at any time before making the application,
resided in Canada.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 222
- 2003, c. 22, s. 103
- [2018, c. 31, s. 152](#1042239-1130813){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042239-1130813.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-222-20050401.html "Link to previous version of section 222"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Inclusion in register

- **[[223]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-223 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  application for registration and special ballot may be made by an
  elector. It shall be in the prescribed form and shall include

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} satisfactory proof of the elector's identity;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2018, c. 31, s. 153\]]{.Repealed}

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the elector's date of birth;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2018, c. 31, s. 153\]]{.Repealed}

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the address of the elector's place of ordinary
    residence;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2018, c. 31, s. 153\]]{.Repealed}

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the elector's mailing address outside Canada; and

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} any other information that the Chief Electoral
    Officer considers necessary to determine the elector's entitlement
    to vote or the electoral district in which he or she may vote.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Optional information

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} In addition to the information specified in
  subsection (1), the Chief Electoral Officer may request that the
  elector provide other information that the Chief Electoral Officer
  considers necessary for implementing agreements made under section 55,
  but the elector is not required to provide that information.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 223, c. 12, s. 40
- [2018, c. 31, s. 153](#1042249-1130818){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042249-1130818.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-223-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 223"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- change of address

**[[224]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-224 .sectionLabel}** The address chosen as
the place of ordinary residence in Canada in the application for
registration and special ballot cannot be changed after the elector's
name is entered in the register.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information to be provided

**[[225]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-225 .sectionLabel}** The Chief Electoral
Officer may require an elector whose name appears in the register to
provide, within the time fixed by the Chief Electoral Officer, any
information that is necessary to update the register.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deletion of names from register

**[[226]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-226 .sectionLabel}** The Chief Electoral
Officer shall delete from the register the name of an elector who

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} does not provide the information referred to in
  section 225 within the time fixed by the Chief Electoral Officer;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} makes a signed request to the Chief Electoral Officer
  to have his or her name deleted from the register;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} has died and concerning whom a request has been
  received to have the elector's name deleted from the register, to
  which request is attached a death certificate or other documentary
  evidence of the death;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} returns to Canada to reside; or

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} cannot be contacted.

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2018, c. 31, s. 154\]]{.Repealed}

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 226
- [2018, c. 31, s. 154](#1042255-1130824){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042255-1130824.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-226-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 226"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Special ballot

- **[[227]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-227
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} After approving an application for
  registration and special ballot and after the issue of the writs, the
  Chief Electoral Officer shall provide a special ballot to every
  elector whose name is entered in the register.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Voting by special ballot

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An elector shall vote by special ballot by

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} writing the name of the candidate of his or her
    choice on the ballot;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} placing the ballot in an inner envelope and sealing
    it;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} signing the declaration prescribed by the Chief
    Electoral Officer; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} placing the inner envelope and the declaration ---
    if it is not on the outer envelope --- in the outer envelope and
    sealing it.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Writing candidate's name

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The candidate shall be indicated on a special ballot
  by writing the candidate's given name or initials and surname. If two
  or more candidates have the same name, their political affiliation
  shall be indicated.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 227
- [2018, c. 31, s. 155](#1042263-1130832){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042263-1130832.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-227-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 227"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Sending of outer envelope

**[[228]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-228 .sectionLabel}** An elector shall send
the sealed outer envelope to the Chief Electoral Officer

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} by mail or any other means; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} by delivering it to a Canadian Embassy, Canadian High
  Commission or Canadian Consular Office, to a Canadian Forces base or
  to any place that the Chief Electoral Officer may designate.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deadline for return of vote

**[[229]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-229 .sectionLabel}** The special ballot must
be received by the special voting rules administrator in the National
Capital Region no later than 6:00 p.m. on polling day in order to be
counted.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 229
- [2018, c. 31, s. 156](#1042270-1111332){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042270-1111332.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-229-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 229"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Responsibilities of elector

**[[230]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-230 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of this
Division, an elector has the sole responsibility to ensure that

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} his or her application for registration and special
  ballot is made within the period specified; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} his or her special ballot is received within the
  period specified to be counted.

### [DIVISION 4]{.HLabel2}[Electors Residing in Canada]{.HTitleText2} {#h-205684 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definition of
[[elector]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}

**[[231]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-231 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of this
Division, [[elector]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an elector, other than
an incarcerated elector, who resides in Canada and who wishes to vote in
accordance with this Division.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 231
- [2018, c. 31, s. 157](#1042272-1132060){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042272-1132060.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-231-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 231"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Conditions for voting by special ballot

- **[[232]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-232 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  elector may vote under this Division if his or her application for
  registration and special ballot is received by a returning officer in
  an electoral district or by the special voting rules administrator
  after the issue of the writs but before 6:00 p.m. on the 6th day
  before polling day.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Conditions for voting by special ballot
  --- specified later day

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If, for the purpose of this subsection, the Chief
  Electoral Officer specifies on his or her Internet site a day that is
  after the 6th day before polling day but before polling day, an
  elector may vote under this Division if his or her application for
  registration and special ballot is received by the returning officer
  in the elector's electoral district or by the special voting rules
  administrator after the issue of the writs but before 6:00 p.m. on the
  specified day.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer may specify a day for the
  purpose of subsection (2) only if he or she considers that the
  integrity of the vote will not be affected if applications for
  registration and special ballots are received after 6:00 p.m. on the
  6th day before polling day.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 232
- [2018, c. 31, s. 157](#1042272-1132070){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042272-1132070.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-232-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 232"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information required for application

- **[[233]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-233 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  application for registration and special ballot shall be in the
  prescribed form and shall include the following information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the elector's name and the address of his or her
    place of ordinary residence;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the elector's date of birth;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} satisfactory proof of the elector's identity and
    residence;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the elector's mailing address; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} any other information that the Chief Electoral
    Officer considers necessary to determine the elector's entitlement
    to vote or the electoral district in which he or she may vote.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Electors in danger

  [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} An elector who would be under reasonable
  apprehension of bodily harm if he or she were to indicate the address
  of his or her place of ordinary residence or his or her mailing
  address for the purpose of paragraph (1)(a) or (d) may apply to the
  returning officer or special voting rules administrator to use another
  address for that purpose. The returning officer or special voting
  rules administrator, unless he or she considers that it would not be
  in the public interest to do so, shall grant the application and shall
  not reveal the addresses in respect of which the application is made
  except as required to send the special ballot to the elector. For
  greater certainty, the granting of the application does not change the
  elector's place of ordinary residence for the purposes of this Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Optional information

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} In addition to the information specified in
  subsection (1), the Chief Electoral Officer may request that the
  elector provide other information that the Chief Electoral Officer
  considers necessary to implement agreements made under section 55, but
  the elector is not required to provide that information.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2018, c. 31, s. 158\]]{.Repealed}

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 233
- 2014, c. 12, s. 59
- [2018, c. 31, s. 158](#1042282-1132075){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042282-1132075.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-233-20141219.html "Link to previous version of section 233"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[234]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-234 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed, 2018, c.
31, s. 159\]]{.Repealed}

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-234-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 234"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Vote by special ballot only

**[[235]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-235 .sectionLabel}** Once an elector's
application for registration and special ballot has been accepted, the
elector may only vote under this Division.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}List of electors

**[[236]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-236 .sectionLabel}** Once an elector's
application for registration and special ballot has been accepted by the
returning officer or special voting rules administrator, he or she shall
ensure, in accordance with the Chief Election Officer's instructions,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} that the elector's name is entered on the list of
  electors for the polling division of the elector's place of ordinary
  residence, if it is not already included on a list of electors; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} that there is an indication on the list of electors
  that the elector has received a special ballot.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 236
- [2018, c. 31, s. 160](#1042291-1132083){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1042291-1132083.html"}
:::

[Previous
Version](section-236-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 236"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Provision of ballot

- **[[237]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-237
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2) and
  section 237.1, on acceptance of an elector's application for
  registration and special ballot, the elector shall be provided with a
  special ballot.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Provision of ballot and envelopes

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If section 241 applies, then, on acceptance of an
  elector's application for registration and special ballot, the elector
  shall be given a ballot, an inner envelope and an outer envelope.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 237
- 2014, c. 12, s. 60
- [2018, c. 31, s. 160](#1042291-1132089){.wb-lbx

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Proof of identity and residence

- **[[237.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-237.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If an elector goes to the office of
  a returning officer to receive his or her ballot or special ballot,
  then before receiving it the elector shall prove his or her identity
  and residence in accordance with section 143.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Presence of candidate or representative

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A candidate or their representative may be present at
  the office when the elector

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} receives the ballot;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} places the folded ballot in the inner envelope and
    seals it; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} places the inner envelope in the outer envelope and
    seals it.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Examination of identification documents

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The candidate or representative may examine but not
  handle any piece of identification provided by the elector.

- [(3.1)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2018, c. 31, s. 161\]]{.Repealed}

- [(3.2)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2018, c. 31, s. 161\]]{.Repealed}

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application of provisions

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section, the following
  provisions apply with any necessary modifications in respect of the
  location in the returning officer's office where the elector receives
  his or her ballot or special ballot as though that location were a
  polling station:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} sections 135 to 137;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} sections 143 to 144;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} subsection 164(1);

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} section 166;

  - [(d.1)]{.lawlabel} subsections 281.6(1) to (4);

  - [(d.2)]{.lawlabel} section 282.2; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} paragraph 489(3)(c).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 60
- [2018, c. 31, s. 161](#1042305-1132096){.wb-lbx
