#### [SUBDIVISION B]{.HLabel3}[Financial Administration of Registered Parties]{.HTitleText3} {#h-207792 .Subheading}

##### [General]{.HTitleText4} {#h-207793 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duty of chief agent

**[[425]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-425 .sectionLabel}** The chief agent of a
registered party is responsible for administering its financial
transactions and for reporting on them in accordance with this Act.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 425
- 2003, c. 19, s. 35
- 2006, c. 9, s. 50
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-425-20070101.html "Link to previous version of section 425"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- paying expenses

- **[[426]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-426 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No
  person or entity, other than a registered agent of a registered party
  or a person authorized under subsection 381(1), shall pay the
  registered party's expenses.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- incurring expenses

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to section 348.02, no person or entity, other
  than a registered agent of a registered party, shall incur the
  registered party's expenses.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Expenses incurred by registered agent
  other than chief agent

  [(2.1)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (2), a registered agent ---
  other than the chief agent --- of a registered party shall, before
  incurring the party's expenses, obtain the written authorization of
  the chief agent to incur those expenses, and shall incur them only in
  accordance with that authorization.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- accepting
  contributions, borrowing

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} No person or entity, other than a registered agent of
  a registered party, shall accept contributions to the registered party
  or borrow money on its behalf.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- accepting or providing
  goods, services or funds

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} No person or entity, other than a registered agent of
  a registered party, shall, on behalf of the registered party,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} accept a provision of goods or services, or a
    transfer of funds, if the provision or transfer is permitted under
    section 364; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} provide goods or services, or transfer funds, if
    the provision or transfer is permitted under that section.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 426
- 2003, c. 19, s. 36
- 2014, c. 12, ss. 86, 155
- [2018, c. 31, s. 261](#1043007-1133405){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043007-1133405.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-426-20150802.html "Link to previous version of section 426"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Recovery of Claims for Debts]{.HTitleText4} {#h-207811 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Claim for payment

**[[427]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-427 .sectionLabel}** A person who has a
claim to be paid for a debt of a registered party shall send the invoice
or other document evidencing the claim to the registered party or one of
its registered agents.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 427
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-427-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 427"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Payment within three years

**[[428]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-428 .sectionLabel}** If a claim for an
expense is evidenced by an invoice or other document that has been sent
under section 427, the claim shall be paid within three years after the
day on which payment of it is due.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 428
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-428-20040101.html "Link to previous version of section 428"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Proceedings to recover payment

**[[429]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-429 .sectionLabel}** A person who has sent
an invoice or other document evidencing a claim under section 427 may
commence proceedings in a court of competent jurisdiction to recover any
unpaid amount

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} at any time, if the registered agent refuses to pay
  that amount or disputes that it is payable; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} after the end of the period referred to in section
  428, in any other case.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 429
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-429-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 429"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Maximum Partisan Advertising Expenses]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1133406 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Maximum partisan advertising expenses

- **[[429.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-429.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The maximum amount that is allowed
  for partisan advertising expenses of a registered party for a
  pre-election period is \$1,400,000.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Inflation adjustment factor

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The amount referred to in subsection (1) shall be
  multiplied by the inflation adjustment factor referred to in section
  384 that is in effect on the first day of the pre-election period.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 31, s. 262](#1043009-1133413){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043009-1133413.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- partisan advertising
expenses more than maximum amount

- **[[429.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-429.2
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No chief agent of a registered party
  shall incur partisan advertising expenses on the party's behalf of a
  total amount of more than the maximum amount calculated under section
  429.1.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- circumventing maximum
  amount

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} No registered party shall circumvent, or attempt to
  circumvent, that maximum amount in any manner, including by acting in
  collusion with a potential candidate for the purpose of his or her
  engaging in partisan advertising so that the combined total of the
  following exceeds the maximum amount:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the potential candidate's partisan advertising
    expenses that relate to the partisan advertising engaged in in
    collusion with the party; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the party's partisan advertising expenses.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- collusion by third
  party

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} No third party, within the meaning of paragraph (a.1)
  of the definition [[third party]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in section
  349, shall act in collusion with a registered party for the purpose of
  the registered party's circumventing that maximum amount.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 31, s. 262](#1043009-1133424){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043009-1133424.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Message to be authorized

**[[429.3]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-429.3 .sectionLabel}** A registered party,
or a person acting on its behalf, that causes partisan advertising to be
conducted shall mention in or on the partisan advertising message that
its transmission was authorized by one of the party's registered agents.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 31, s. 262](#1043009-1133428){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043009-1133428.html"}
:::

##### [Maximum Election Expenses]{.HTitleText4} {#h-207826 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Maximum election expenses

- **[[430]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-430 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  maximum amount that is allowed for election expenses of a registered
  party for an election is the product of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} \$0.735 multiplied by the number of names on the
    preliminary lists of electors for electoral districts in which the
    registered party has endorsed a candidate or by the number of names
    on the revised lists of electors for those electoral districts,
    whichever is greater, and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the inflation adjustment factor published by the
    Chief Electoral Officer under section 384 that is in effect on the
    date of the issue of the writ or writs for the election.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Maximum expenses: postponement of
  polling day

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the Governor in Council orders the postponement of
  an election under subsection 59(4) for one or more electoral
  districts, along with the corresponding extension of the election
  period, then the maximum amount calculated under subsection (1) for a
  registered party that has endorsed a candidate in that or any of those
  electoral districts is increased by adding to it the product of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} \$0.735 multiplied by the number of names on the
    preliminary list of electors in the electoral districts governed by
    the order in which the party has endorsed a candidate, or the number
    of names on the revised list of electors in those electoral
    districts, whichever is greater, and divided by the number of days
    in the election period before it was extended;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the inflation adjustment factor published by the
    Chief Electoral Officer under section 384 that is in effect on the
    date of the issue of the writ or writs for the election; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the number of days by which the election period is
    extended.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Amounts not included in election
  expenses

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of subsections (1) and (2), an
  election expense of a registered party does not include

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a transfer made by or on behalf of it to candidates
    in the election; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an expense incurred by it through a registered
    agent, or person authorized under subsection 381(1), who was not
    acting within the scope of the registered agent's authority.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 430
- 2003, c. 19, s. 38
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
- [2018, c. 31, s. 263](#1043011-1133434){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043011-1133434.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-430-20141219.html "Link to previous version of section 430"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- election expenses more
than maximum

- **[[431]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-431 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No
  chief agent of a registered party shall incur election expenses on the
  party's behalf of a total amount of more than the maximum amount
  calculated under section 430.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- collusion

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} No registered party and no third party, within the
  meaning of paragraph (b) of the definition [[third
  party]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in section 349, shall act in collusion
  with each other for the purpose of the registered party's
  circumventing the maximum amount referred to in subsection (1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 431
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
- [2018, c. 31, s. 264](#1043015-1133437){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043015-1133437.html"}
:::

[Previous

##### [Financial Reporting]{.HTitleText4} {#h-207849 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Financial transactions return

- **[[432]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-432 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For
  each fiscal period of a registered party, its chief agent shall
  provide the Chief Electoral Officer with

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a financial transactions return, in the prescribed
    form, on the registered party's financial transactions;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the auditor's report on the return made under
    subsection 435(1); and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a declaration in the prescribed form by the chief
    agent that the return is complete and accurate.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Contents of return

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A financial transactions return shall set out

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the total amount of contributions received by the
    registered party;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the number of contributors;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of each contributor who made
    contributions of a total amount of more than \$200 to the registered
    party, that total amount, as well as the amount of each of those
    contributions and the date on which the party received it;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of each contributor who has
    made a contribution to the registered party that includes a directed
    contribution as defined in subsection 365(2), the amount of the
    contribution, the amount of the directed contribution and the date
    on which the party received it;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the registered party's assets and
    liabilities and any surplus or deficit in accordance with generally
    accepted accounting principles, including a statement of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} claims that are the subject of proceedings under
      section 429, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} unpaid claims, including those resulting from
      loans made to the registered party under section 373;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the registered party's revenues and
    expenses in accordance with generally accepted accounting
    principles;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} a statement, for each electoral district, of the
    commercial value of goods or services provided and of funds
    transferred by the registered party to a candidate or the electoral
    district association;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} a statement of each amount transferred to a
    leadership contestant out of a directed contribution as defined in
    subsection 365(2), the information referred to in paragraph (d) with
    respect to the contributor and the name of the leadership contestant
    to whom the amount has been transferred;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the commercial value of goods or
    services provided and of funds transferred to the registered party
    from any of its registered associations, a nomination contestant, a
    candidate or a leadership contestant;

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} a return for election expenses incurred for each
    by-election during the fiscal period that sets out

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} as an election expense, each of

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the expenses incurred by the registered party
        --- other than accessibility expenses --- whether paid or
        unpaid, including a statement of expenses incurred for [[voter
        contact calling services]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in
        section 348.01, provided by a [[calling service
        provider]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in that section,
        that indicates the name of that provider and the amount of those
        expenses, and

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} the non-monetary contributions used by the
        registered party as an election expense, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the accessibility expenses incurred by the
      registered party;

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the terms and conditions of each
    loan made to the registered party under section 373, including the
    amount of the loan, the interest rate, the lender's name and
    address, the dates and amounts of repayments of principal and
    payments of interest and, if there is a guarantor, the guarantor's
    name and address and the amount guaranteed; and

  - [(l)]{.lawlabel} a statement of contributions received by the
    registered party but returned in whole or in part to the
    contributors or otherwise dealt with in accordance with this Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Report

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If there is any amendment to the information in a
  statement referred to in paragraph (2)(k), including with respect to
  the giving of a guarantee or suretyship, then the registered party's
  chief agent shall without delay provide the Chief Electoral Officer
  with a report on the amendment in the prescribed form.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Publication

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer shall, in the manner that
  he or she considers appropriate, publish the information in a
  statement referred to in paragraph (2)(k) and any report provided
  under subsection (3) as soon as feasible after receiving the
  information or report.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Period for providing documents

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The documents referred to in subsection (1) shall be
  provided to the Chief Electoral Officer within six months after the
  end of the fiscal period.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Statement of unpaid claims

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} The statement of unpaid claims referred to in
  subparagraph (2)(e)(ii) shall include information indicating

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} each unpaid claim in the statement for the previous
    fiscal period that has been paid in full since that statement was
    provided; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} each claim that remains unpaid 18 months after the
    day on which it was due and each claim that remains unpaid 36 months
    after the day on which it was due.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Unpaid claims --- 18 months or more

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} The statement shall include the following information
  concerning claims referred to in paragraph (6)(b):

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} whether any part of the unpaid amount is disputed
    and, if so, what steps the parties have taken to resolve the
    dispute;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} whether the claim is the subject of proceedings
    under section 429;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} whether the unpaid amount of a loan is the subject
    of proceedings to secure its payment, or of a dispute as to the
    amount that was to be paid or the amount that remains unpaid;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} whether the parties have agreed on a repayment
    schedule and, if so, whether repayments are being made according to
    the schedule;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} whether the unpaid amount has been written off by
    the creditor as an uncollectable debt in accordance with the
    creditor's normal accounting practices; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} any other relevant information that could help
    explain why the amount is unpaid.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 432
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
- [2018, c. 31, s. 265](#1043019-1133442){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043019-1133442.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-432-20141219.html "Link to previous version of section 432"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Quarterly returns

- **[[433]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-433 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a
  registered party's candidates for the most recent general election
  received at that election at least 2% of the number of valid votes
  cast, or at least 5% of the number of valid votes cast in the
  electoral districts in which the registered party endorsed a
  candidate, the registered party's chief agent shall, for each quarter
  --- in respect of a fiscal period of the registered party --- that
  follows that general election, beginning with the quarter that
  immediately follows that general election and ending with the quarter
  in which polling day at the next general election is held, provide the
  Chief Electoral Officer with a return that includes the information
  required under paragraphs 432(2)(a) to (d), (i) and (l).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Period for providing return

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A quarterly return shall be provided within 30 days
  after the end of the period to which it relates.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 433
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
- [2018, c. 31, s. 266](#1043023-1133444){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043023-1133444.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-433-20141219.html "Link to previous version of section 433"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}When contributions forwarded to Receiver
General

**[[434]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-434 .sectionLabel}** If the name of the
contributor of a contribution of more than \$20 to a registered party,
or the name or address of a contributor who has made contributions of a
total amount of more than \$200 to a registered party, is not known, one
of the registered party's registered agents shall, without delay, pay an
amount of money equal to the value of the contribution to the Chief
Electoral Officer, who shall forward it to the Receiver General.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 434
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-434-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 434"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Auditor's report

- **[[435]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-435 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  registered party's auditor shall report to the party's chief agent on
  the party's financial transactions return and shall, in accordance
  with generally accepted auditing standards, make any examination that
  will enable the auditor to give an opinion in the report as to whether
  the return presents fairly the information contained in the financial
  records on which the return is based.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Statement

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The auditor shall include in the report any statement
  that the auditor considers necessary if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the financial transactions return that is the
    subject of the report does not present fairly and in accordance with
    generally accepted accounting principles the information contained
    in the financial records on which it is based;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the auditor has not received all of the information
    and explanations that the auditor required; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} based on the examination, it appears that the
    registered party has not kept proper financial records.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Right of access

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The auditor shall have access at any reasonable time
  to all of the party's documents, and may require the party's
  registered agents and officers to provide any information or
  explanation that, in the auditor's opinion, may be necessary to enable
  the auditor to prepare the report.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 435
- 2003, c. 19, s. 39
- 2014, c. 12, ss. 84, 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- false, misleading or
incomplete document

**[[436]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-436 .sectionLabel}** No chief agent of a
registered party shall provide the Chief Electoral Officer with a
document referred to in paragraph 432(1)(a) that

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the chief agent knows or ought reasonably to know
  contains a material statement that is false or misleading; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} does not substantially set out the information
  required under subsection 432(2) or, in the case of a statement of
  unpaid claims referred to in subparagraph 432(2)(e)(ii), does not
  substantially set out information required under subsection 432(6) or
  (7).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 436
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-436-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 436"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Reporting on Expenses]{.HTitleText4} {#h-207970 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Election expenses return

- **[[437]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-437 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For
  a general election, the chief agent of a registered party shall
  provide the Chief Electoral Officer with

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an election expenses return in the prescribed form;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the auditor's report referred to in subsection
    438(1) on that return; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a declaration in the prescribed form by the chief
    agent that the return is complete and accurate.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Contents of return

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An election expenses return shall set out

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} as an election expense, each of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the expenses incurred by the registered party ---
      other than accessibility expenses --- whether paid or unpaid,
      including a statement of expenses incurred for [[voter contact
      calling services]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section
      348.01, provided by a [[calling service
      provider]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in that section, that
      indicates the name of that provider and the amount of those
      expenses, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the non-monetary contributions used by the
      registered party as an election expense;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the accessibility expenses incurred by the
    registered party; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a general election held on a day set
    in accordance with subsection 56.1(2) or section 56.2, the partisan
    advertising expenses incurred by the registered party in relation to
    partisan advertising messages transmitted during the pre-election
    period.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Period for providing documents

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The registered party's chief agent shall provide the
  Chief Electoral Officer with the documents referred to in
  subsection (1) within eight months after the polling day for the
  general election.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 437
- 2003, c. 19, s. 41
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
- [2018, c. 31, s. 268](#1043040-1133452){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043040-1133452.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-437-20141219.html "Link to previous version of section 437"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Auditor's report

- **[[438]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-438 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} As
  soon as feasible after a general election, a registered party's
  auditor shall report to its chief agent on its return on general
  election expenses and shall, in accordance with generally accepted
  auditing standards, make any examination that will enable the auditor
  to give an opinion in the report as to whether the return presents
  fairly the information contained in the financial records on which the
  return is based and the registered party and the chief agent have
  complied with the requirements of Division 1 of this Part and this
  Division.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Statement

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The auditor shall include in the report under
  subsection (1) any statement that the auditor considers necessary if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the return that is the subject of the report does
    not present fairly the information contained in the financial
    records on which the return is based;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the auditor has not received all of the information
    and explanations that the auditor required;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} based on the examination, it appears that the
    registered party has not kept proper financial records; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} based on the examination, it appears that the
    registered party and the chief agent have not complied with the
    requirements of Division 1 of this Part and this Division.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Right of access

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The auditor for a registered party shall have access
  at any reasonable time to all of the party's documents, and may
  require the party's registered agents and officers to provide any
  information or explanation that, in the auditor's opinion, may be
  necessary to enable the auditor to prepare the report.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 438
- 2003, c. 19, s. 42
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-438-20040101.html "Link to previous version of section 438"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- false, misleading or
incomplete document

**[[439]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-439 .sectionLabel}** No chief agent of a
registered party shall provide the Chief Electoral Officer with a
document referred to in paragraph 437(1)(a) that

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the chief agent knows or ought reasonably to know
  contains a material statement that is false or misleading; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} does not substantially set out the information
  required under subsection 437(2).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 439
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-439-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 439"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Corrections, Revisions and Extended Reporting Periods]{.HTitleText4} {#h-208004 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Minor corrections --- Chief Electoral
Officer

- **[[440]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-440 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  Chief Electoral Officer may correct a document referred to in
  subsection 432(1) or 437(1) if the correction does not materially
  affect its substance.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Corrections or revisions at request of
  Chief Electoral Officer

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer may in writing request a
  registered party's chief agent to correct or revise, within a
  specified period, a document referred to in subsection 432(1) or
  437(1).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deadline for correction or revision

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If the Chief Electoral Officer requests a correction
  or revision, the registered party's chief agent shall provide him or
  her with the corrected or revised version of the document within the
  specified period.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 440
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-440-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 440"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Extensions --- Chief Electoral Officer

- **[[441]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-441 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  Chief Electoral Officer, on the written application of a registered
  party's chief agent or, if the chief agent is absent or unable to
  perform their duties, its leader, shall authorize the extension of a
  period referred to in subsection 432(5) or 437(3) unless he or she is
  satisfied that the chief agent's failure to provide the required
  documents was deliberate or was the result of the chief agent's
  failure to exercise due diligence.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deadline

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The application may be made within the period
  referred to in subsection 432(5) or 437(3) or within two weeks after
  the end of that period.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 441
- 2001, c. 21, s. 22
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-441-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 441"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Corrections or revisions --- Chief
Electoral Officer

- **[[442]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-442 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  Chief Electoral Officer, on the written application of a registered
  party's chief agent or, if the chief agent is absent or unable to
  perform their duties, its leader, shall authorize the correction or
  revision of a document referred to in subsection 432(1) or 437(1) if
  he or she is satisfied by the evidence submitted by the applicant that
  the correction or revision is necessary in order for the requirements
  of this Act to be complied with.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application made without delay

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The application shall be made immediately after the
  applicant becomes aware of the need for correction or revision.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deadline for corrections or revisions

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The applicant shall provide the Chief Electoral
  Officer with the corrected or revised version of the document within
  30 days after the day on which the correction or revision is
  authorized or within any extension of that period authorized under
  subsection (4) or (5).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}New deadline

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer, on the written
  application of the applicant made within two weeks after the end of
  the 30-day period referred to in subsection (3), shall authorize the
  extension of that period, unless he or she is satisfied that the
  applicant's failure to provide the corrected or revised version of the
  document was deliberate or was the result of the applicant's failure
  to exercise due diligence.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Extension of new deadline

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer, on the written
  application of the applicant made within two weeks after the end of an
  extension authorized under subsection (4) or under this subsection,
  shall authorize the further extension of that period, unless he or she
  is satisfied that the applicant's failure to provide the corrected or
  revised version of the document was deliberate or was the result of
  the applicant's failure to exercise due diligence.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 442
- 2007, c. 21, s. 34
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-442-20080301.html "Link to previous version of section 442"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Extensions, corrections or revisions ---
judge

- **[[443]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-443 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  chief agent of a registered party or, if the chief agent is absent or
  unable to perform their duties, its leader, may apply to a judge for
  an order

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} relieving the chief agent from the obligation to
    comply with a request referred to in subsection 440(2);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} authorizing an extension referred to in subsection
    441(1); or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} authorizing a correction or revision referred to in
    subsection 442(1).

  The applicant shall notify the Chief Electoral Officer that the
  application has been made.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deadline

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The application may be made

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} under paragraph (1)(a), within the specified period
    referred to in subsection 440(2) or within the two weeks after the
    end of that period;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} under paragraph (1)(b), within two weeks after, as
    the case may be,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} if an application for an extension is not made to
      the Chief Electoral Officer within the period referred to in
      subsection 441(2), the end of the two-week period referred to in
      that subsection,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the rejection of an application for an extension
      made in accordance with section 441, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the end of the extended period referred to in
      subsection 441(1); or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} under paragraph (1)(c), within two weeks after the
    rejection of an application for a correction or revision made in
    accordance with section 442.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Grounds --- relief from compliance

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The judge shall grant an order relieving the chief
  agent from the obligation to comply with a request referred to in
  subsection 440(2) if the judge is satisfied by the evidence submitted
  by the applicant that the correction or revision is not necessary in
  order for the requirements of this Act to be complied with.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Grounds --- extension

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The judge shall grant an order authorizing an
  extension unless the judge is satisfied that the chief agent's failure
  to provide the required documents was deliberate or was the result of
  the chief agent's failure to exercise due diligence.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Grounds --- corrections or revisions

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The judge shall grant an order authorizing a
  correction or revision if the judge is satisfied by the evidence
  submitted by the applicant that the correction or revision is
  necessary in order for the requirements of this Act to be complied
  with.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Contents of order

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} The order may require that the applicant satisfy any
  condition that the judge considers necessary for carrying out the
  purposes of this Act.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 443
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-443-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 443"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Reimbursement of Election Expenses and Accessibility Expenses]{.HTitleText4} {#h-208059 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Certificate

- **[[444]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-444 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} On
  receipt from a registered party of the documents referred to in
  subsection 437(1), the Chief Electoral Officer shall provide the
  Receiver General with a certificate that sets out the amount that is
  the sum of 50% of the registered party's election expenses, as set out
  in the return for its general election expenses, that were paid by its
  registered agents and 90% --- to a maximum of \$250,000 --- of the
  registered party's accessibility expenses, as set out in that return,
  that were paid by its registered agents, if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the Chief Electoral Officer is satisfied --- even
    despite any statement that the registered party's auditor has
    included under paragraph 438(2)(d) in a report under subsection
    438(1) --- that the registered party and its chief agent have
    complied with the requirements of sections 437 to 443;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the auditor's report does not include a statement
    referred to in any of paragraphs 438(2)(a) to (c); and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} candidates endorsed by the registered party
    received at least

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} 2% of the number of valid votes cast at the
      election, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} 5% of the number of valid votes cast in the
      electoral districts in which the registered party endorsed a
      candidate.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Reduction of reimbursement

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the election expenses, as set out in the election
  expenses return, exceed the maximum amount that is allowed under
  section 430, the amount that is provided for in subsection (1) is
  reduced as follows, without at any time being less than zero:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} by one dollar for every dollar that exceeds the
    maximum amount by less than 5%;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} by two dollars for every dollar that exceeds the
    maximum amount by 5% or more but by less than 10%;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} by three dollars for every dollar that exceeds the
    maximum amount by 10% or more but by less than 12.5%; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} by four dollars for every dollar that exceeds the
    maximum amount by 12.5% or more.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Reimbursement

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} On receipt of the certificate, the Receiver General
  shall reimburse the amount set out in it to the registered party by
  paying that amount out of the Consolidated Revenue Fund.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 444
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
- [2018, c. 31, s. 270](#1043053-1133455){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043053-1133455.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-444-20141219.html "Link to previous version of section 444"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Quarterly Allowances]{.HTitleText4} {#h-208078 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Quarterly allowance

- **[[445]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-445 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  Chief Electoral Officer shall determine, for each quarter of a
  calendar year, an allowance payable to a registered party whose
  candidates for the most recent general election preceding that quarter
  received at that election at least

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} 2% of the number of valid votes cast; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} 5% of the number of valid votes cast in the
    electoral districts in which the registered party endorsed a
    candidate.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Computation of fund

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An allowance fund for a quarter is the product of the
  number of valid votes cast in the election referred to in
  subsection (1) multiplied by the applicable following number:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} \$0.255, for the quarter that begins on April 1,
    2013 and the three following quarters; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} \$0.1275, for the quarter that begins on April 1,
    2014 and the three following quarters.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Computation of party's allowance

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Each such registered party's allowance for a quarter
  is that part of the allowance fund for that quarter that corresponds
  to its percentage of valid votes cast in the election referred to in
  subsection (1).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Merger of parties

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} A merged party is entitled to the aggregate of the
  allowances to which the merging parties of which it is composed would
  have been entitled had they not merged.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 445
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-445-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 445"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Certificate

- **[[446]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-446 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} As
  soon as feasible after the end of each quarter, the Chief Electoral
  Officer shall provide the Receiver General with a certificate that
  sets out the amount of the allowance payable to a registered party for
  that quarter.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Delay for non-compliance

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a registered party has not provided all of the
  documents that it is required to provide under sections 432, 433 and
  437, the Chief Electoral Officer shall postpone providing the
  certificate for any quarter until the party has provided those
  documents.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Payment

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} On receipt of the certificate, the Receiver General
  shall pay the amount set out in it to the registered party out of the
  Consolidated Revenue Fund. The payment may also be made in whole or in
  part to any provincial division of the party, as authorized in writing
  by the party's leader.

- Definition of [[provincial division]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} In this Act, [[provincial
  division]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a division of a registered party
  for a province or territory in relation to which the party's leader
  has provided the following to the Chief Electoral Officer:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name of the division and of the province or
    territory;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the name of the party;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the address of the office where records of that
    division are maintained and to which communications may be
    addressed;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the names and addresses of the chief executive
    officer and other officers of the division;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of any registered agent
    appointed by the division; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a declaration signed by the party's leader
    certifying that the division is a division of the party.

  This Act applies to information provided under this subsection as if
  it were information referred to in paragraphs 385(2)(a) to (h).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Report of changes in information

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} Within 15 days after a change in the information
  referred to in subsection (4), the chief executive officer of the
  provincial division shall report the change in writing to the chief
  agent of the registered party.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 446
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-446-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 446"){.PITLink}
:::

### [DIVISION 3]{.HLabel2}[Electoral District Associations]{.HTitleText2} {#h-208114 .Subheading}

#### [SUBDIVISION A]{.HLabel3}[Registration of Electoral District Associations]{.HTitleText3} {#h-208115 .Subheading}

##### [Registration]{.HTitleText4} {#h-208116 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- accepting contributions,
etc., while not registered

**[[447]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-447 .sectionLabel}** No electoral district
association of a registered party shall, unless it is registered,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} accept contributions;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} provide goods or services or transfer funds to a
  candidate endorsed by a registered party;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} provide goods or services or transfer funds to a
  registered party or a registered association; or

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} accept surplus nomination campaign funds of a
  nomination contestant, surplus electoral funds of a candidate or
  surplus leadership campaign funds of a leadership contestant.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 447
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-447-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 447"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Contents of application

- **[[448]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-448 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  electoral district association of a registered party may submit to the
  Chief Electoral Officer an application for registration that includes

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the full name of the association and of the
    electoral district;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the full name of the registered party;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the address of the association's office where
    records are maintained and to which communications may be addressed;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the names and addresses of the chief executive
    officer and other officers of the association;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of the appointed auditor of
    the association; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of the financial agent of the
    association.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Accompanying documents

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The application shall be accompanied by

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the signed consent of the financial agent to act in
    that capacity;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the signed consent of the auditor to act in that
    capacity; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a declaration signed by the leader of the party
    certifying that the electoral district association is an electoral
    district association of the party.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Examination of application

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer shall register an
  electoral district association that meets the requirements of
  subsections (1) and (2). In the case of a refusal to register, the
  Chief Electoral Officer shall indicate to the association which of the
  requirements have not been met.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Date of registration

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} An electoral district association is registered as of
  the date on which the Chief Electoral Officer registers it in the
  registry of electoral district associations.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 448
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-448-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 448"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Only one registered association per
district

**[[449]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-449 .sectionLabel}** A registered party may
have at most one registered association in an electoral district.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 449
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-449-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 449"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- incurring partisan
advertising expenses, etc.

- **[[449.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-449.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No electoral district association of
  a registered party shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} incur partisan advertising expenses in relation to
    partisan advertising messages that promote or oppose a registered
    party or an eligible party and that are transmitted during a
    pre-election period; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} transmit or cause to be transmitted, during a
    pre-election period, partisan advertising messages that promote or
    oppose a registered party or an eligible party.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Despite paragraph (1)(a), an electoral district
  association of a registered party may incur partisan advertising
  expenses to the extent that the goods or services that the partisan
  advertising expense is incurred for are

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} provided to that party, if permitted under
    paragraph 364(2)(b); or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} sold to that party.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (1), an electoral district
  association of a registered party may

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} incur partisan advertising expenses for the
    transmission of partisan advertising messages referred to in
    paragraph (1)(a) to the extent that those messages are intended to
    be transmitted solely, or substantially solely, within the
    association's electoral district; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} transmit or cause to be transmitted partisan
    advertising messages referred to in paragraph (1)(b) to the extent
    that those messages are transmitted solely, or substantially solely,
    within the association's electoral district.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 31, s. 271](#1043057-1133470){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043057-1133470.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Message to be authorized

**[[449.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-449.2 .sectionLabel}** A registered
association that causes partisan advertising to be conducted shall
mention in or on the partisan advertising message that its transmission
was authorized by one of the association's electoral district agents.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 31, s. 271](#1043057-1133474){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043057-1133474.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- incurring election
expenses

- **[[450]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-450 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No
  electoral district association of a registered party shall incur
  election expenses.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Election expenses --- electoral
  district associations

  [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1),

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} [[election expense]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} has the
    meaning given to that expression by subsection 376(1), except that
    the reference to "a registered party or a candidate" is to be read
    as a reference to "an electoral district association"; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} subsections 376(2) to (4) apply, other than
    paragraph 376(3)(c), except that the reference to "a registered
    party or a candidate" in subsection 376(4) is to be read as a
    reference to "an electoral district association".

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(1.2)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (1), an electoral district
  association of a registered party may incur an election expense to the
  extent that the property or service that the cost was incurred for or
  the non-monetary contribution was received for --- or the goods or
  services that were accepted --- are

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} provided to that party, a registered association of
    that party or a candidate endorsed by that party, if permitted under
    paragraph 364(2)(b); or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} sold to that party or a candidate endorsed by that
    party.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Uncancellable transmission

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} In the case of a general election that is not held on
  a day set in accordance with subsection 56.1(2) or section 56.2, or of
  a by-election, an electoral district association is deemed not to have
  incurred an election expense for election advertising if, on the issue
  of the writ or writs, it is not able to cancel the transmission of the
  election advertising message that the expense is in relation to.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 450
- 2003, c. 19, s. 43
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
- [2018, c. 31, s. 271](#1043057-1133488){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043057-1133488.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-450-20141219.html "Link to previous version of section 450"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Statement of assets and liabilities

**[[451]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-451 .sectionLabel}** Within six months after
the day on which it becomes a registered association, the association
shall provide the Chief Electoral Officer with

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a statement, prepared in accordance with generally
  accepted accounting principles, of its assets and liabilities,
  including any surplus or deficit, as of the day before the effective
  date of the registration; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a declaration in the prescribed form by its financial
  agent that the statement is complete and accurate.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 451
- 2003, c. 19, s. 44
- 2006, c. 9, s. 52
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-451-20070101.html "Link to previous version of section 451"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- declaration concerning
statement

**[[452]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-452 .sectionLabel}** No financial agent of a
registered association shall make a declaration referred to in paragraph
451(b) if the agent knows or ought reasonably to know that the statement
referred to in paragraph 451(a) is not complete and accurate.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 452
- 2003, c. 19, s. 45
- 2006, c. 9, s. 53
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-452-20070101.html "Link to previous version of section 452"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Annual fiscal period

**[[453]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-453 .sectionLabel}** The fiscal period of a
registered association is the calendar year.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 453
- 2003, c. 19, s. 46
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-453-20040101.html "Link to previous version of section 453"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Adjustment of fiscal period

**[[454]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-454 .sectionLabel}** Without delay after
becoming registered, a registered association shall, if necessary,
adjust its fiscal period so that it ends at the end of the calendar
year. The adjusted fiscal period shall not be less than six months or
more than 18 months.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 454
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-454-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 454"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Registry of electoral district
associations

**[[455]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-455 .sectionLabel}** The Chief Electoral
Officer shall maintain a registry of electoral district associations
that contains the information referred to in subsections 448(1), 456(2)
and 471(2).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 455
- 2004, c. 24, s. 19
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-455-20040514.html "Link to previous version of section 455"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Electoral District Agents and Auditors]{.HTitleText4} {#h-208178 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Appointments

- **[[456]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-456 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  registered association may appoint, as electoral district agents,
  persons who are authorized by the association to accept contributions
  and to incur and pay expenses on behalf of the association. The
  appointment is subject to any terms and conditions that it specifies.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Report of appointment

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Within 30 days after the day on which an electoral
  district agent is appointed, the registered association shall provide
  the Chief Electoral Officer with a written report, certified by its
  financial agent, that includes the electoral district agent's name and
  address and any terms and conditions to which the appointment is
  subject. The Chief Electoral Officer shall register that information
  in the registry of electoral district associations.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 456
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-456-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 456"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Agents --- corporations

- **[[457]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-457 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  corporation incorporated under the laws of Canada or a province is
  eligible to be the financial agent or an electoral district agent of a
  registered association.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Agents --- ineligible persons

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The following persons are ineligible to be a
  financial agent or an electoral district agent:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an election officer or a member of the staff of a
    returning officer;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a candidate;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an auditor appointed as required by this Act;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} subject to subsection (1), a person who is not an
    elector;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} an undischarged bankrupt; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a person who does not have full capacity to enter
    into contracts in the province in which the person ordinarily
    resides.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}If member of partnership appointed as
  agent

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A person may be appointed as agent for a registered
  association even if the person is a member of a partnership that has
  been appointed as an auditor, in accordance with this Act, for the
  registered party.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 457
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-457-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 457"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Auditor --- eligibility

- **[[458]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-458 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Only
  the following are eligible to be an auditor for a registered
  association:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a person who is a member in good standing of a
    corporation, association or institute of professional accountants;
    or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a partnership of which every partner is a member in
    good standing of a corporation, association or institute of
    professional accountants.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Auditor --- ineligibility

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The following persons are ineligible to be an
  auditor:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an election officer or a member of the staff of a
    returning officer;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a candidate or their official agent;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a chief agent of a registered party or an eligible
    party;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a registered agent of a registered party;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} an electoral district agent of a registered
    association;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a nomination contestant or their financial agent;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} a leadership contestant or their leadership
    campaign agent; and

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} a financial agent of a registered third party.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 458
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-458-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 458"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Consent

**[[459]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-459 .sectionLabel}** A registered
association shall obtain from its financial agent and auditor, on
appointment, their signed consent to act in that capacity.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 459
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-459-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 459"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Replacement of financial agent or auditor

**[[460]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-460 .sectionLabel}** In the event of the
death, incapacity, resignation or ineligibility of its financial agent
or auditor, or the revocation of the appointment of one, a registered
association shall without delay appoint a replacement.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 460
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-460-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 460"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Only one financial agent and auditor

**[[461]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-461 .sectionLabel}** A registered
association shall have no more than one financial agent and one auditor
at a time.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 461
- 2003, c. 19, s. 47
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-461-20040101.html "Link to previous version of section 461"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- agents

- **[[462]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-462 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No
  person who is ineligible to be a financial agent or an electoral
  district agent of a registered association shall act in that capacity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- auditor

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person who is ineligible to be an auditor of a
  registered association shall act in that capacity.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 462
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-462-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 462"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Changes in Information Concerning Registered Associations]{.HTitleText4} {#h-208237 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Changes in information

- **[[463]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-463
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Within 30 days after the day on
  which there is a change in the information referred to in subsection
  448(1) other than paragraph 448(1)(b), a registered association shall
  report the change to the Chief Electoral Officer in writing. The
  report shall be certified by the chief executive officer of the
  association.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}New financial agent or auditor

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the report involves the replacement of the
  registered association's financial agent or auditor, it shall include
  a copy of the signed consent referred to in section 459.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Registration of change

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer shall enter any change in
  the information referred to in this section in the registry of
  electoral district associations.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 463
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-463-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 463"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Confirmation of registration yearly

**[[464]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-464 .sectionLabel}** On or before May 31 of
every year a registered association shall provide the Chief Electoral
Officer with

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a statement certified by its chief executive officer
  confirming the validity of the information concerning the association
  in the registry of electoral district associations; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} if there is a change in that information, the report
  of the change made under subsection 463(1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 464
- 2003, c. 19, s. 48
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
- [2018, c. 31, s. 272](#1043061-1133490){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043061-1133490.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-464-20141219.html "Link to previous version of section 464"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Deregistration of Registered Associations]{.HTitleText4} {#h-208253 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deregistration --- failure to provide
documents

**[[465]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-465 .sectionLabel}** The Chief Electoral
Officer may deregister a registered association if the association fails
to provide

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} any of the documents referred to in section 451;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a report under subsection 456(2) concerning the
  appointment of an electoral district agent;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} any of the documents referred to in subsection 463(1)
  or (2) with respect to a replacement of its financial agent or
  auditor;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} a report under subsection 463(1) concerning a change
  in any other registered information;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} confirmation under section 464 of the validity of the
  registered information; or

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} a report that is required to be filed under
  subsection 476.1(1) by the registered association.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 465
- 2003, c. 19, s. 49
- 2014, c. 12, ss. 85, 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-465-20140619.html "Link to previous version of section 465"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deregistration --- failure to file return

**[[466]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-466 .sectionLabel}** The Chief Electoral
Officer may deregister a registered association if its financial agent
fails to provide him or her with a document for a fiscal period in
accordance with subsection 475.4(1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 466
- 2003, c. 19, s. 50
- 2007, c. 21, s. 35
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-466-20070726.html "Link to previous version of section 466"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Voluntary deregistration

- **[[467]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-467 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} On
  application by a registered association to become deregistered, signed
  by its chief executive officer and its financial agent, the Chief
  Electoral Officer may deregister the association.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deregistration at request of party

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} On application by a registered party, signed by its
  leader and two of its officers, to deregister one of its registered
  associations, the Chief Electoral Officer shall deregister the
  association.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsections (1) and (2) do not apply during an
  election period in the electoral district of the registered
  association.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 467
- 2001, c. 21, s. 23(F)
- 2003, c. 19, s. 50
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-467-20040101.html "Link to previous version of section 467"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Procedure for non-voluntary
deregistration

- **[[468]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-468 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If
  the Chief Electoral Officer believes on reasonable grounds that a
  registered association or its financial agent has omitted to perform
  any obligation referred to in section 465 or 466, the Chief Electoral
  Officer shall, in writing, notify the association's chief executive
  officer and its financial agent that the association or financial
  agent must

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} rectify the omission by the discharge of that
    obligation within 30 days after receipt of the notice; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} satisfy the Chief Electoral Officer that the
    omission was not the result of negligence or a lack of good faith.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Extension or exemption

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If paragraph (1)(b) applies, the Chief Electoral
  Officer may amend the notice by

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} exempting, in whole or in part, the recipients of
    the notice from complying with the obligations referred to in
    section 465 or 466; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} specifying a period for compliance with the
    obligations referred to in paragraph (1)(a).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Copy of notice

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A copy of any notice or amendment under
  subsection (1) or (2) shall be sent to the leader and the chief agent
  of the registered party with which the registered association is
  affiliated.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deregistration

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer may deregister a
  registered association if the association or its financial agent fails
  to comply with a notice referred to in subsection (1) or with a notice
  amended under subsection (2).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 468
- 2003, c. 19, s. 51
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-468-20040101.html "Link to previous version of section 468"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}[Electoral Boundaries Readjustment
Act](/eng/acts/E-3)

- **[[469]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-469 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If
  the boundaries of an electoral district are revised as a result of a
  representation order made under section 25 of the [Electoral
  Boundaries Readjustment Act](/eng/acts/E-3), a registered association
  for the electoral district may, before the day on which the
  representation order comes into force under subsection 25(1) of that
  Act, file with the Chief Electoral Officer a notice that it will be
  continued as the registered association for a particular electoral
  district described in the representation order. The notice shall be
  accompanied by a consent signed by the leader of the registered party
  with which it is affiliated.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Effect of continuation

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a notice has been filed under subsection (1), on
  the day on which the representation order comes into force, the
  registered association is continued as the registered association for
  the electoral district specified in the notice and assumes all the
  rights and obligations of the association for the former electoral
  district.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deregistration

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Any registered association in an electoral district
  whose boundaries are revised as a result of a representation order
  made under section 25 of the [Electoral Boundaries Readjustment
  Act](/eng/acts/E-3) that does not give a notice under subsection (1)
  is deregistered on the day on which the representation order comes
  into force under subsection 25(1) of that Act and, despite paragraph
  447(c), may provide goods or transfer funds to the registered party
  with which it is affiliated or to any of its registered associations
  in the six months after that day. Any such transfer is not a
  contribution for the purposes of this Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Registration

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} As soon as a proclamation is issued under section 25
  of the [Electoral Boundaries Readjustment Act](/eng/acts/E-3) relating
  to a representation order, an application may be made under section
  448 for the registration of an electoral district association for an
  electoral district that is created by --- or whose boundaries are
  revised as a result of --- the order. The electoral district
  association may be registered at any time on or after the day on which
  the application is made.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Applicant deemed to be electoral
  district association

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The applicant in an application referred to in
  subsection (4) is deemed to be an electoral district association as of
  the date on which the application is received by the Chief Electoral
  Officer.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 469
- 2003, c. 19, s. 52
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
- [2018, c. 31, s. 273](#1043065-1133493){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043065-1133493.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-469-20141219.html "Link to previous version of section 469"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of deregistration

- **[[470]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-470 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If
  the Chief Electoral Officer proposes to deregister a registered
  association under section 467 or subsection 468(4), he or she shall,
  in writing, so notify the association and the registered party with
  which it is affiliated.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Date of deregistration

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The notice shall specify the effective date of the
  deregistration, which shall be at least 15 days after the day on which
  the notice is sent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Proof of service

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The notice shall be sent by registered mail or by a
  method of courier service that provides proof of mailing, a record
  while in transit and a record of delivery.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 470
- 2003, c. 19, s. 53
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-470-20040101.html "Link to previous version of section 470"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Publication

- **[[471]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-471 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a
  registered association is deregistered for any reason other than the
  deregistration of the registered party with which it is affiliated,
  the Chief Electoral Officer shall without delay cause a notice of
  deregistration to be published in the [Canada
  Gazette](http://www.gazette.gc.ca/).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Entry of deregistration in registry of
  electoral district associations

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer shall indicate any
  deregistration of a registered association in the registry of
  electoral district associations.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 471
- 2003, c. 19, s. 54
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-471-20040101.html "Link to previous version of section 471"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Effect of deregistration

**[[472]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-472 .sectionLabel}** An electoral district
association that is deregistered continues to have the obligations of a
registered association for the purpose of section 473.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 472
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-472-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 472"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Fiscal period and returns

**[[473]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-473 .sectionLabel}** The financial agent of
a deregistered electoral district association shall, within six months
after the day of its deregistration, provide the Chief Electoral Officer
with the documents referred to in subsection 475.4(1) for

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the portion of its current fiscal period ending on
  the day of its deregistration; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} any earlier fiscal period for which those documents
  have not already been provided under that subsection.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 473
- 2003, c. 19, s. 55
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-473-20040101.html "Link to previous version of section 473"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [SUBDIVISION B]{.HLabel3}[Financial Administration of Registered Associations]{.HTitleText3} {#h-208331 .Subheading}

##### [General]{.HTitleText4} {#h-208332 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duty of financial agent

**[[474]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-474 .sectionLabel}** The financial agent of
a registered association is responsible for administering its financial
transactions and for reporting on them in accordance with this Act.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 474
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-474-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 474"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- paying expenses

- **[[475]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-475 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No
  person or entity, other than an electoral district agent of a
  registered association, shall pay the registered association's
  expenses.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- incurring expenses

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to section 348.02, no person or entity, other
  than an electoral district agent of a registered association, shall
  incur the registered association's expenses.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- accepting
  contributions, borrowing

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} No person or entity, other than an electoral district
  agent of a registered association, shall accept contributions to the
  registered association or borrow money on its behalf.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- accepting or providing
  goods, services or funds

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} No person or entity, other than the financial agent
  of a registered association, shall, on behalf of the registered
  association,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} accept a provision of goods or services, or a
    transfer of funds, if the provision or transfer is permitted under
    section 364; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} provide goods or services, or transfer funds, if
    the provision or transfer is permitted under that section.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 475
- 2014, c. 12, ss. 86, 155
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-475-20141219.html "Link to previous version of section 475"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Recovery of Claims for Debts]{.HTitleText4} {#h-208350 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Claim for payment

**[[475.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-475.1 .sectionLabel}** A person who has a
claim to be paid for a debt of a registered association shall send the
invoice or other document evidencing the claim to the registered
association or one of its electoral district agents.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Payment within three years

**[[475.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-475.2 .sectionLabel}** If a claim for an
expense is evidenced by an invoice or other document that has been sent
under section 475.1, the claim shall be paid within three years after
the day on which payment of it is due.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Proceedings to recover payment

**[[475.3]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-475.3 .sectionLabel}** A person who has
sent an invoice or other document evidencing a claim under section 475.1
may commence proceedings in a court of competent jurisdiction to recover
any unpaid amount

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} at any time, if the electoral district agent refuses
  to pay that amount or disputes that it is payable; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} after the end of the period referred to in section
  475.2, in any other case.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

##### [Financial Reporting]{.HTitleText4} {#h-208365 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Financial transactions return

- **[[475.4]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-475.4
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For each fiscal period of a
  registered association, its financial agent shall provide the Chief
  Electoral Officer with

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a financial transactions return, in the prescribed
    form, on the association's financial transactions;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the auditor's report on the return, if one is
    required under subsection 475.6(1); and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a declaration in the prescribed form by the
    financial agent that the return is complete and accurate.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Contents of return

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A financial transactions return shall set out

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the total amount of contributions received by the
    registered association;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the number of contributors;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of each contributor who made
    contributions of a total amount of more than \$200 to the registered
    association, that total amount, as well as the amount of each of
    those contributions and the date on which the association received
    it;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the registered association's assets
    and liabilities and any surplus or deficit in accordance with
    generally accepted accounting principles, including a statement of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} claims that are the subject of proceedings under
      section 475.3, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} unpaid claims, including those resulting from
      loans made to the registered association under section 373;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the registered association's
    revenues and expenses in accordance with generally accepted
    accounting principles, including a statement of expenses incurred
    for voter contact calling services as defined in section 348.01,
    provided by a calling service provider as defined in that section,
    that indicates the name of that provider and the amount of those
    expenses;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the commercial value of goods or
    services provided and of funds transferred by the registered
    association to the registered party, to another registered
    association or to a candidate endorsed by the registered party;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the commercial value of goods or
    services provided and of funds transferred to the registered
    association from the registered party, another registered
    association, a nomination contestant, a candidate or a leadership
    contestant;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the terms and conditions of each
    loan made to the registered association under section 373, including
    the amount of the loan, the interest rate, the lender's name and
    address, the dates and amounts of repayments of principal and
    payments of interest and, if there is a guarantor, the guarantor's
    name and address and the amount guaranteed; and

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a statement of contributions received by the
    registered association but returned in whole or in part to the
