    contributors or otherwise dealt with in accordance with this Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Report

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If there is any amendment to the information in a
  statement referred to in paragraph (2)(h), including with respect to
  the giving of a guarantee or suretyship, then the registered
  association's financial agent shall without delay provide the Chief
  Electoral Officer with a report on the amendment in the prescribed
  form.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Publication

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer shall, in the manner that
  he or she considers appropriate, publish the information in a
  statement referred to in paragraph (2)(h) and any report provided
  under subsection (3) as soon as feasible after receiving the
  information or report.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Period for providing documents

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The documents referred to in subsection (1) shall be
  provided to the Chief Electoral Officer within five months after the
  end of the fiscal period.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Statement of unpaid claims

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} The statement of unpaid claims referred to in
  subparagraph (2)(d)(ii) shall include information indicating

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} each unpaid claim in the statement for the previous
    fiscal period that has been paid in full since that statement was
    provided; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} each claim that remains unpaid 18 months after the
    day on which it was due and each claim that remains unpaid 36 months
    after the day on which it was due.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Unpaid claims --- 18 months or more

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} The statement shall include the following information
  concerning claims referred to in paragraph (6)(b):

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} whether any part of the unpaid amount is disputed
    and, if so, what steps the parties have taken to resolve the
    dispute;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} whether the claim is the subject of proceedings
    under section 475.3;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} whether the unpaid amount of a loan is the subject
    of proceedings to secure its payment, or of a dispute as to the
    amount that was to be paid or the amount that remains unpaid;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} whether the parties have agreed on a repayment
    schedule and, if so, whether repayments are being made according to
    the schedule;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} whether the unpaid amount has been written off by
    the creditor as an uncollectable debt in accordance with the
    creditor's normal accounting practices; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} any other relevant information that could help
    explain why the amount is unpaid.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}When contributions forwarded to Receiver
General

**[[475.5]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-475.5 .sectionLabel}** If the name of the
contributor of a contribution of more than \$20 to a registered
association, or the name or address of a contributor who has made
contributions of a total amount of more than \$200 to a registered
association, is not known, the registered association's financial agent
shall, without delay, pay an amount of money equal to the value of the
contribution to the Chief Electoral Officer, who shall forward it to the
Receiver General.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Auditor's report

- **[[475.6]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-475.6
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The auditor of a registered
  association that has, in a fiscal period, accepted contributions of
  \$10,000 or more in total or incurred expenses of \$10,000 or more in
  total shall report to the association's financial agent on the
  association's financial transactions return and shall, in accordance
  with generally accepted auditing standards, make any examination that
  will enable the auditor to give an opinion in the report as to whether
  the return presents fairly the information contained in the financial
  records on which it is based.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Statement

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The auditor shall include in the report any statement
  that the auditor considers necessary if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the financial transactions return that is the
    subject of the report does not present fairly and in accordance with
    generally accepted accounting principles the information contained
    in the financial records on which it is based;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the auditor has not received all of the information
    and explanations that the auditor required; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} based on the examination, it appears that the
    registered association has not kept proper financial records.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Right of access

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The auditor shall have access at any reasonable time
  to all of the association's documents, and may require the
  association's electoral district agents to provide any information or
  explanation that, in the auditor's opinion, may be necessary to enable
  the auditor to prepare the report.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
- [2018, c. 31, s. 274](#1043069-1133495){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043069-1133495.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-475.6-20141219.html "Link to previous version of section 475.6"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- false, misleading or
incomplete document

**[[475.7]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-475.7 .sectionLabel}** No financial agent
of a registered association shall provide the Chief Electoral Officer
with a document referred to in paragraph 475.4(1)(a) that

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the financial agent knows or ought reasonably to know
  contains a material statement that is false or misleading; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} does not substantially set out the information
  required under subsection 475.4(2) or, in the case of a statement of
  unpaid claims referred to in subparagraph 475.4(2)(d)(ii), does not
  substantially set out information required under subsection 475.4(6)
  or (7).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

##### [Payment of Audit Expenses]{.HTitleText4} {#h-208427 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Certificate --- audit expenses

- **[[475.8]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-475.8
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} On receipt of the documents referred
  to in subsection 475.4(1) and a copy of the auditor's invoice, the
  Chief Electoral Officer shall provide the Receiver General with a
  certificate that sets out the amount, up to a maximum of \$1,500, of
  the expenses incurred for the audit made under subsection 475.6(1).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Payment

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} On receipt of the certificate, the Receiver General
  shall pay the amount set out in it to the auditor out of the
  Consolidated Revenue Fund.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Inflation adjustment factor

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The \$1,500 amount set out in subsection (1) shall be
  multiplied by the inflation adjustment factor referred to in section
  384 that is in effect on the last day of the registered association's
  fiscal period to which the auditor's report relates.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
- [2018, c. 31, s. 275](#1043073-1133498){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043073-1133498.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-475.8-20141219.html "Link to previous version of section 475.8"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Corrections, Revisions and Extended Reporting Periods]{.HTitleText4} {#h-208435 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Minor corrections --- Chief Electoral
Officer

- **[[475.9]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-475.9
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer may
  correct a document referred to in subsection 475.4(1) if the
  correction does not materially affect its substance.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Corrections or revisions at request of
  Chief Electoral Officer

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer may in writing request a
  registered association's financial agent to correct or revise, within
  a specified period, a document referred to in subsection 475.4(1).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deadline for corrections or revision

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If the Chief Electoral Officer requests the
  correction or revision, the registered association's financial agent
  shall provide him or her with the corrected or revised version of the
  document within the specified period.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Extensions --- Chief Electoral Officer

- **[[475.91]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-475.91
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer, on the
  written application of a registered association's financial agent or,
  if the financial agent is absent or unable to perform their duties,
  its chief executive officer, shall authorize the extension of a period
  referred to in subsection 475.4(5) unless he or she is satisfied that
  the financial agent's failure to provide the required documents was
  deliberate or was the result of their failure to exercise due
  diligence.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deadline

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The application may be made within the period
  referred to in subsection 475.4(5) or within two weeks after the end
  of that period.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Corrections or revisions --- Chief
Electoral Officer

- **[[475.92]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-475.92
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer, on the
  written application of a registered association's financial agent or,
  if the financial agent is absent or unable to perform their duties,
  its chief executive officer, shall authorize the correction or
  revision of a document referred to in subsection 475.4(1) if he or she
  is satisfied by the evidence submitted by the applicant that the
  correction or revision is necessary in order for the requirements of
  this Act to be complied with.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application made without delay

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The application shall be made immediately after the
  applicant becomes aware of the need for correction or revision.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deadline for corrections or revisions

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The applicant shall provide the Chief Electoral
  Officer with the corrected or revised version of the document within
  30 days after the day on which the correction or revision is
  authorized or within any extension of that period authorized under
  subsection (4) or (5).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}New deadline

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer, on the written
  application of the applicant made within two weeks after the end of
  the 30-day period referred to in subsection (3), shall authorize the
  extension of that period, unless he or she is satisfied that the
  applicant's failure to provide the corrected or revised version of the
  document was deliberate or was the result of their failure to exercise
  due diligence.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Extension of new deadline

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer, on the written
  application of the applicant made within two weeks after the end of an
  extension authorized under subsection (4) or under this subsection,
  shall authorize the further extension of that period, unless he or she
  is satisfied that the applicant's failure to provide the corrected or
  revised version of the document was deliberate or was the result of
  their failure to exercise due diligence.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Extensions, corrections or revisions ---
judge

- **[[475.93]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-475.93
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The financial agent of a registered
  association or, if the financial agent is absent or unable to perform
  their duties, its chief executive officer, may apply to a judge for an
  order

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} relieving the financial agent from the obligation
    to comply with a request referred to in subsection 475.9(2);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} authorizing an extension referred to in subsection
    475.91(1); or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} authorizing a correction or revision referred to in
    subsection 475.92(1).

  The applicant shall notify the Chief Electoral Officer that the
  application has been made.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deadline

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The application may be made

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} under paragraph (1)(a), within the specified period
    referred to in subsection 475.9(2) or within the two weeks after the
    end of that period;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} under paragraph (1)(b), within two weeks after, as
    the case may be,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} if an application for an extension is not made to
      the Chief Electoral Officer within the period referred to in
      subsection 475.91(2), the end of the two-week period referred to
      in that subsection,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the rejection of an application for an extension
      made in accordance with section 475.91, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the end of the extended period referred to in
      subsection 475.91(1); or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} under paragraph (1)(c), within two weeks after the
    rejection of an application for a correction or revision made in
    accordance with section 475.92.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Grounds --- relief from compliance

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The judge shall grant an order relieving the
  financial agent from the obligation to comply with a request referred
  to in subsection 475.9(2) if the judge is satisfied by the evidence
  submitted by the applicant that the correction or revision is not
  necessary in order for the requirements of this Act to be complied
  with.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Grounds --- extension

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The judge shall grant an order authorizing an
  extension unless the judge is satisfied that the financial agent's
  failure to provide the required documents was deliberate or was the
  result of the financial agent's failure to exercise due diligence.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Grounds --- correction or revision

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The judge shall grant an order authorizing a
  correction or revision if the judge is satisfied by the evidence
  submitted by the applicant that the correction or revision is
  necessary in order for the requirements of this Act to be complied
  with.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Contents of order

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} An order under subsection (1) may require that the
  applicant satisfy any condition that the judge considers necessary for
  carrying out the purposes of this Act.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

### [DIVISION 4]{.HLabel2}[Nomination Contestants]{.HTitleText2} {#h-208490 .Subheading}

#### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText3} {#h-208491 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definition of [[selection
date]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}

**[[476]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476 .sectionLabel}** In this Division,
[[selection date]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the date on which a
nomination contest is decided. ([date de désignation]{.DefinedTermLink
lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 476
- 2003, c. 19, s. 56
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
- [2018, c. 31, s. 277](#1043079-1133501){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043079-1133501.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-476-20141219.html "Link to previous version of section 476"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[476.01]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.01 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed,
2018, c. 31, s. 399\]]{.Repealed}

**[[476.02]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.02 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed,
2018, c. 31, s. 399\]]{.Repealed}

#### [SUBDIVISION A]{.HLabel3}[Nomination Contest Report]{.HTitleText3} {#h-208504 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of nomination contest

- **[[476.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} When a nomination contest is held,
  the registered party, or the registered association if the contest was
  held by the registered association, shall, within 30 days after the
  selection date, file with the Chief Electoral Officer a report setting
  out

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name of the electoral district, the registered
    association and the registered party that the nomination contest
    concerns;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the date on which the nomination contest began and
    the selection date;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of each nomination contestant
    as of the selection date and of their financial agent; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the name of the person selected in the nomination
    contest.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer shall, in the manner that
  he or she considers appropriate, communicate to each nomination
  contestant the information related to that contestant that was
  reported under subsection (1).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Publication

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer shall, in the manner that
  he or she considers appropriate, publish a notice containing the
  information referred to in subsection (1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deeming

**[[476.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.2 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
Division 1 of this Part and this Division, a nomination contestant is
deemed to have been a nomination contestant from the time they accept a
contribution, incur a nomination campaign expense or borrow money under
section 373.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duty to appoint financial agent

**[[476.3]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.3 .sectionLabel}** A nomination
contestant shall appoint a financial agent before accepting a
contribution or incurring a nomination campaign expense.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Financial agent --- ineligibility

- **[[476.4]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.4
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The following persons are ineligible
  to be the financial agent of a nomination contestant:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an election officer or a member of the staff of a
    returning officer;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a candidate or a nomination contestant;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an auditor appointed as required by this Act;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a person who is not an elector;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} an undischarged bankrupt; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a person who does not have full capacity to enter
    into contracts in the province in which the person ordinarily
    resides.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}If partnership appointed as auditor

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A person may be appointed as financial agent for a
  nomination contestant even if the person is a member of a partnership
  that has been appointed as an auditor, in accordance with this Act,
  for the registered party.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Consent

**[[476.5]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.5 .sectionLabel}** A nomination
contestant shall obtain from the financial agent, on appointment, their
signed consent to act in that capacity.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Replacement of financial agent

**[[476.6]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.6 .sectionLabel}** In the event of the
death, incapacity, resignation or ineligibility of the financial agent,
or the revocation of the appointment of one, the nomination contestant
shall without delay appoint a replacement.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Only one financial agent

**[[476.61]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.61 .sectionLabel}** A nomination
contestant shall have no more than one financial agent at a time.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- financial agents

**[[476.62]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.62 .sectionLabel}** No person who is
ineligible to be a financial agent of a nomination contestant shall act
in that capacity.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Changes in reported information

- **[[476.63]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.63
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Within 30 days after a change in the
  information referred to in paragraph 476.1(1)(c) in respect of a
  nomination contestant, the nomination contestant shall report the
  change in writing to the Chief Electoral Officer.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}New financial agent

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the report involves the replacement of the
  nomination contestant's financial agent, it shall include a copy of
  the signed consent referred to in section 476.5.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

#### [SUBDIVISION B]{.HLabel3}[Financial Administration of Nomination Contestants]{.HTitleText3} {#h-208562 .Subheading}

##### [Powers, Duties and Functions of Financial Agent]{.HTitleText4} {#h-208563 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duty of financial agent

**[[476.64]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.64 .sectionLabel}** A nomination
contestant's financial agent is responsible for administering the
contestant's financial transactions for their nomination campaign and
for reporting on those transactions in accordance with this Act.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Bank account

- **[[476.65]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.65
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A nomination contestant's financial
  agent shall open, for the sole purpose of the contestant's nomination
  campaign, a separate bank account in a Canadian financial institution
  as defined in section 2 of the [Bank Act](/eng/acts/B-1.01), or in an
  authorized foreign bank as defined in that section that is not subject
  to the restrictions and requirements referred to in subsection 524(2)
  of that Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Account holder name

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The account shall name the account holder as follows:
  "(*name of financial agent*), financial agent".

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deposits into account

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} All of a nomination contestant's financial
  transactions in relation to the contestant's nomination campaign that
  involve the receipt of money are to be deposited to the account unless
  the transaction involves the receipt of the contestant's own funds and
  those funds are used to pay a litigation expense or a personal
  expense.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Payments from account

  [(3.1)]{.lawlabel} All of a nomination contestant's financial
  transactions in relation to the contestant's nomination campaign that
  involve the payment of money are to be paid from the account unless
  the transaction involves the payment out of the contestant's own funds
  of a litigation expense or a personal expense.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Closure of bank account

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} After the selection date or the withdrawal or death
  of the nomination contestant, the contestant's financial agent shall
  close the account once all unpaid claims and surplus nomination
  campaign funds have been dealt with in accordance with this Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Final statement of bank account

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The financial agent shall, on closing the account,
  provide the Chief Electoral Officer with the final statement of the
  account.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
- [2018, c. 31, s. 278](#1043083-1133506){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043083-1133506.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-476.65-20141219.html "Link to previous version of section 476.65"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- accepting contributions,
borrowing

- **[[476.66]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.66
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person or entity, other than the
  financial agent of a nomination contestant, shall accept contributions
  to the contestant's nomination campaign or borrow money on the
  contestant's behalf under section 373.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- accepting goods,
  services or funds or transferring funds

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person or entity, other than the financial agent
  of a nomination contestant, shall, on the contestant's behalf,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} accept a provision of goods or services, or a
    transfer of funds, if the provision or transfer is permitted under
    section 364; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} transfer funds, if the transfer is permitted under
    that section.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- accepting certain
  transfers of funds

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} No financial agent of a nomination contestant shall,
  on the contestant's behalf, accept a transfer of funds from a
  registered party or registered association.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- paying nomination
  campaign expenses

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} No person or entity, other than a nomination
  contestant's financial agent, shall pay the contestant's nomination
  campaign expenses except for

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a litigation expense;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} travel and living expenses;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a personal expense; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a petty expense referred to in section 381.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- incurring nomination
  campaign expenses

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} Subject to section 348.02, no person or entity, other
  than the nomination contestant or their financial agent, shall incur
  the contestant's nomination campaign expenses.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- paying contestant's
  personal expenses, etc.

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} No person or entity, other than the nomination
  contestant or their financial agent, shall pay the contestant's
  expenses referred to in any of paragraphs 4(a) to (c).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, ss. 86, 155
- [2018, c. 31, s. 279](#1043096-1133515){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043096-1133515.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-476.66-20150802.html "Link to previous version of section 476.66"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limits on nomination contest expenses

**[[476.67]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.67 .sectionLabel}** The limit for
nomination contest expenses that is allowed for a nomination contestant
in an electoral district is the amount

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} that is 20% of the election expenses limit that was
  calculated under subsection 477.49(1) for that electoral district
  during the immediately preceding general election, if the boundaries
  for the electoral district have not changed since then; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} that the Chief Electoral Officer determines, in any
  other case.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
- 2018, c. 20, s. 4
- [2018, c. 31, s. 280](#1043105-1133518){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043105-1133518.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-476.67-20181221.html "Link to previous version of section 476.67"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- expenses more than
maximum

- **[[476.68]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.68
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No nomination contestant and no
  financial agent of a nomination contestant shall incur total
  nomination contest expenses in an amount that is more than the limit
  allowed for that electoral district under section 476.67.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- collusion

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person or entity shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} circumvent, or attempt to circumvent, the limit
    referred to in section 476.67; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} act in collusion with another person or entity for
    that purpose.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
- 2018, c. 20, s. 5
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-476.68-20141219.html "Link to previous version of section 476.68"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Recovery of Claims for Debts]{.HTitleText4} {#h-208613 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Claim for payment

**[[476.69]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.69 .sectionLabel}** A person who has
a claim to be paid for a nomination campaign expense shall send the
invoice or other document evidencing the claim to the nomination
contestant's financial agent or, if there is no financial agent, to the
nomination contestant.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Payment within three years

- **[[476.7]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.7
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a claim for a nomination campaign
  expense is evidenced by an invoice or other document that has been
  sent under section 476.69, or if a claim for repayment of a loan is
  made to the nomination contestant under section 373, the claim shall
  be paid within three years after the selection date or, in the case
  referred to in subsection 476.75(16), the polling day.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- payment without
  authorization

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} No nomination candidate and no financial agent of a
  nomination contestant shall pay a claim referred to in subsection (1)
  after the end of the three-year period referred to in that subsection
  unless authorized to do so under section 476.72 or 476.73, or ordered
  to do so as a result of proceedings commenced under section 476.74.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Unenforceable contracts

**[[476.71]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.71 .sectionLabel}** A contract in
relation to a nomination campaign is not enforceable against the
nomination contestant unless it was entered into by the contestant
personally or by the contestant's financial agent.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Irregular claims or payments --- Chief
Electoral Officer

- **[[476.72]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.72
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} On the written application of a
  person who has a claim to be paid for a nomination campaign expense in
  relation to a nomination contestant or to be paid for a loan made to
  the contestant under section 373, or on the written application of the
  contestant's financial agent or the contestant, the Chief Electoral
  Officer may, on being satisfied that there are reasonable grounds for
  so doing, in writing authorize the contestant's financial agent to pay
  the amount claimed if the payment of the expense or the repayment of
  the loan was not made within the three-year period referred to in
  subsection 476.7(1).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Conditions

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer may impose any term or
  condition that he or she considers appropriate on a payment authorized
  under subsection (1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Irregular claims or payments --- judge

**[[476.73]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.73 .sectionLabel}** On the
application of a person who has a claim to be paid for a nomination
campaign expense in relation to a nomination contestant or to be paid
for a loan made to the contestant under section 373, or on the
application of the contestant's financial agent or the contestant, a
judge may, on being satisfied that there are reasonable grounds for so
doing, by order authorize the contestant's financial agent to pay the
amount claimed if

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the applicant establishes that an authorization under
  subsection 476.72(1) has been refused and that the payment has not
  been made within the three-year period referred to in subsection
  476.7(1); or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the amount claimed has not been paid in accordance
  with an authorization obtained under subsection 476.72(1) and the
  applicant establishes their inability to comply with the authorization
  for reasons beyond their control.

The applicant shall notify the Chief Electoral Officer that the
application has been made.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Proceedings to recover payment

**[[476.74]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.74 .sectionLabel}** A person who has
sent an invoice or other document evidencing a claim under section
476.69, or has a claim for repayment of a loan made to a nomination
contestant under section 373, may commence proceedings in a court of
competent jurisdiction to recover any unpaid amount

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} at any time, if the nomination contestant or their
  financial agent refuses to pay that amount or disputes that it is
  payable; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} after the end of the three-year period referred to in
  subsection 476.7(1) or any extension of that period authorized under
  subsection 476.72(1) or section 476.73, in any other case.

The nomination contestant shall notify the Chief Electoral Officer that
the proceedings have been commenced.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

##### [Nomination Campaign Return]{.HTitleText4} {#h-208650 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Nomination campaign return

- **[[476.75]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.75
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A nomination contestant's financial
  agent who has accepted contributions of \$1,000 or more in total or
  incurred nomination campaign expenses of \$1,000 or more in total
  shall provide the Chief Electoral Officer with the following in
  respect of a nomination contest:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a nomination campaign return, in the prescribed
    form, on the financing and nomination campaign expenses for the
    nomination campaign;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the appointment of an auditor is required under
    subsection 476.77(1), the auditor's report on the return made under
    section 476.8;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a declaration in the prescribed form by the
    financial agent that the return is complete and accurate; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a declaration in the prescribed form by the
    nomination contestant that the return is complete and accurate.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Contents of return

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The nomination campaign return shall set out

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a statement of nomination contest expenses;

  - [(a.1)]{.lawlabel} a statement of litigation expenses that includes
    an indication of which of those expenses were paid other than from
    the bank account referred to in subsection 476.65(1) and the source
    of the funds used to pay them;

  - [(a.2)]{.lawlabel} a statement of travel and living expenses;

  - [(a.3)]{.lawlabel} a statement of personal expenses that includes an
    indication of which of those expenses were paid other than from the
    bank account referred to in subsection 476.65(1) and the source of
    the funds used to pay them;

  - [(a.4)]{.lawlabel} a statement of nomination campaign expenses,
    other than the expenses referred to in paragraphs (a) to (a.3);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a statement of claims that are the subject of
    proceedings under section 476.74;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a statement of unpaid claims, including those
    resulting from loans made to the nomination contestant under section
    373;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the terms and conditions of each
    loan made to the nomination contestant under section 373, including
    the amount of the loan, the interest rate, the lender's name and
    address, the dates and amounts of repayments of principal and
    payments of interest, the unpaid principal remaining at the end of
    each calendar year and, if there is a guarantor, the guarantor's
    name and address and the amount guaranteed;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the total amount of contributions received by the
    nomination contestant;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the number of contributors;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of each contributor who made
    contributions of a total amount of more than \$200 to the nomination
    contestant, that total amount, as well as the amount of each of
    those contributions and the date on which the contestant received
    it;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the funds transferred by the
    nomination contestant to a registered party, a registered
    association or a candidate;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the commercial value of goods or
    services provided to the nomination contestant by a registered party
    or a registered association;

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the commercial value of goods or
    services provided and of funds transferred to the nomination
    contestant from themselves in their capacity as a candidate; and

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} a statement of contributions received but returned
    in whole or in part to the contributors or otherwise dealt with in
    accordance with this Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Supporting documents

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Together with the nomination campaign return, the
  nomination contestant's financial agent shall provide the Chief
  Electoral Officer with documents evidencing expenses set out in the
  return, including bank statements, deposit slips, cancelled cheques
  and the contestant's written statement referred to in subsection
  476.82(1).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Additional supporting documents

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} If the Chief Electoral Officer is of the opinion that
  the documents provided under subsection (3) are not sufficient, he or
  she may require the financial agent to provide by a specified date any
  additional documents that are necessary for the financial agent to
  comply with that subsection.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Report

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} If there is any amendment to the information in a
  statement referred to in paragraph (2)(d), including with respect to
  the giving of a guarantee or suretyship in respect of the loan, then
  the nomination contestant's financial agent shall without delay
  provide the Chief Electoral Officer with a report on the amendment in
  the prescribed form.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Publication

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer shall, in the manner that
  he or she considers appropriate, publish the information in a
  statement referred to in paragraph (2)(d) and any report provided
  under subsection (5) as soon as feasible after receiving the
  information or report.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Period for providing documents

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} The documents referred to in subsection (1) shall be
  provided to the Chief Electoral Officer within four months after the
  selection date.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Declaration of nomination contestant

  [(8)]{.lawlabel} A nomination contestant shall, within four months
  after the selection date, send their financial agent the declaration
  referred to in paragraph (1)(d).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Death of nomination contestant

  [(9)]{.lawlabel} If a nomination contestant dies without having sent
  the declaration within the period referred to in subsection (8),

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} they are deemed to have sent the declaration in
    accordance with that subsection;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the financial agent is deemed to have provided the
    declaration to the Chief Electoral Officer in accordance with
    subsection (1); and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the Chief Electoral Officer is deemed to have
    received the declaration for the purpose of section 476.901.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Payment of unpaid claims

  [(10)]{.lawlabel} If a claim --- including one resulting from a loan
  --- is paid in full after the return under paragraph (1)(a) is
  provided to the Chief Electoral Officer, the nomination contestant's
  financial agent shall provide the Chief Electoral Officer with a
  report in the prescribed form on the payment of the claim within 30
  days after the day on which the payment is made, including information
  indicating the source of the funds used to pay the claim.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}First update

  [(11)]{.lawlabel} The nomination contestant's financial agent shall
  provide the Chief Electoral Officer with an updated version of the
  statement of unpaid claims referred to in paragraph (2)(c), as of the
  day that is 18 months after the selection date, within the period that
  begins 18 months after the selection date and ends 19 months after the
  selection date. The updated version shall include the following
  information concerning the unpaid amount of a claim, including one
  resulting from a loan:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} whether any part of the unpaid amount is disputed
    and, if so, what steps the parties have taken to resolve the
    dispute;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} whether the claim is the subject of proceedings
    under section 476.74;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} whether the unpaid amount of a loan is the subject
    of proceedings to secure its payment, or of a dispute as to the
    amount that was to be paid or the amount that remains unpaid;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} whether the parties have agreed on a repayment
    schedule and, if so, whether repayments are being made according to
    the schedule;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} whether the unpaid amount has been written off by
    the creditor as an uncollectable debt in accordance with the
    creditor's normal accounting practices; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} any other relevant information that could help
    explain why the amount is unpaid.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Second update

  [(12)]{.lawlabel} The nomination contestant's financial agent shall
  provide the Chief Electoral Officer with an updated version of the
  statement of unpaid claims referred to in paragraph (2)(c), as of the
  day that is 36 months after the selection date, within the period that
  begins 36 months after the selection date and ends 37 months after the
  selection date. The updated version shall include the information
  referred to in paragraphs (11)(a) to (f).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Supporting documents

  [(13)]{.lawlabel} Together with the updated versions of the statement
  of unpaid claims referred to in subsections (11) and (12), the
  nomination contestant's financial agent shall provide the Chief
  Electoral Officer with documents evidenc­ing the matters referred to in
  paragraphs (11)(a) to (f), including, if paragraph (11)(d) applies, a
  copy of the repayment schedule.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Additional supporting documents

  [(14)]{.lawlabel} If the Chief Electoral Officer is of the opinion
  that the documents provided under subsection (13) are not sufficient,
  he or she may require the financial agent to provide by a specified
  date any additional documents that are necessary for the financial
  agent to comply with that subsection.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Irregular claims and payments

  [(15)]{.lawlabel} The nomination contestant's financial agent shall
  provide the Chief Electoral Officer with a report in the prescribed
  form on the payment of a claim that was subject to an authorization to
  pay under section 476.72 or 476.73 or to an order to pay resulting
  from proceedings commenced under section 476.74. The financial agent
  shall provide the report within 30 days after the day on which the
  payment is made and shall include in it information indicating the
  source of the funds used to pay the claim.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Selection date

  [(16)]{.lawlabel} In applying subsections (7), (8), (11) and (12), if
  the selection date of a nomination contest falls within an election
  period for that electoral district or the 30 days before it, then a
  reference to "selection date" is to be read as a reference to "polling
  day".

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
- 2018, c. 20, s. 6
- [2018, c. 31, ss. 282, 399](#1043124-1133531){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043124-1133531.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-476.75-20181221.html "Link to previous version of section 476.75"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}When contributions forwarded to Receiver
General

**[[476.76]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.76 .sectionLabel}** If the name of
the contributor of a contribution of more than \$20 to a nomination
contestant, or the name or address of a contributor who has made
contributions of a total amount of more than \$200 to a nomination
contestant, is not known, the nomination contestant's financial agent
shall, without delay, pay an amount of money equal to the value of the
contribution to the Chief Electoral Officer, who shall forward it to the
Receiver General.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Appointment of auditor

- **[[476.77]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.77
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A nomination contestant who has
  accepted contributions of \$10,000 or more in total or incurred
  nomination campaign expenses of \$10,000 or more in total shall
  appoint an auditor without delay.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Auditor --- eligibility

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Only the following are eligible to be an auditor for
  a nomination contestant:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a person who is a member in good standing of a
    corporation, association or institute of professional accountants;
    or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a partnership in which every partner is a member in
    good standing of a corporation, association or institute of
    professional accountants.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Auditor --- ineligibility

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The following persons are ineligible to be an
  auditor:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an election officer or a member of the staff of a
    returning officer;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a chief agent of a registered party or an eligible
    party, or a registered agent of a registered party;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a candidate or their official agent;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} an electoral district agent of a registered
    association;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a leadership contestant or their leadership
    campaign agent;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a nomination contestant or their financial agent;
    and

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} a financial agent of a registered third party.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notification of appointment

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Every nomination contestant, without delay after an
  auditor is appointed, shall provide the Chief Electoral Officer with
  the auditor's name, address, telephone number and occupation and their
  signed consent to act in that capacity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}New auditor

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} If a nomination contestant's auditor is replaced, the
  contestant shall, without delay, provide the Chief Electoral Officer
  with the new auditor's name, address, telephone number and occupation
  and their signed consent to act in that capacity.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Only one auditor

**[[476.78]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.78 .sectionLabel}** A nomination
contestant shall have no more than one auditor at a time.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- auditors

**[[476.79]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.79 .sectionLabel}** No person who is
ineligible to be an auditor of a nomination contestant shall act in that
capacity.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Auditor's report

- **[[476.8]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.8
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A nomination contestant's auditor
  appointed in accordance with subsection 476.77(1) shall, as soon as
  feasible after the selection date, report to the contestant's
  financial agent on the nomination campaign return for that campaign
  and shall, in accordance with generally accepted auditing standards,
  make any examination that will enable the auditor to give an opinion
  in the report as to whether the return presents fairly the information
  contained in the financial records on which it is based.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Statement

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The auditor shall include in the report any statement
  that the auditor considers necessary if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the return does not present fairly the information
    contained in the financial records on which it is based;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the auditor has not received all of the information
    and explanations that the auditor required; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} based on the examination, it appears that the
    financial agent has not kept proper financial records.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Right of access

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The auditor shall have access at any reasonable time
  to all of the nomination contestant's documents, and may require the
  contestant and their financial agent to provide any information or
  explanation that, in the auditor's opinion, may be necessary to enable
  the auditor to prepare the report.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Ineligible to prepare report

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} No person referred to in subsection 476.77(3) who is
  a partner or an associate of a nomination contestant's auditor or who
  is an employee of that auditor, or of the firm in which that auditor
  is a partner or associate, shall participate, other than in the manner
  referred to in subsection (3), in the preparation of the auditor's
  report.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Nomination contestants outside Canada

- **[[476.81]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.81
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection 476.75(7), a
  nomination contestant who is outside Canada when the documents
  referred to in paragraphs 476.75(1)(a) to (c) are provided to the
  Chief Electoral Officer need not send their financial agent the
  declaration referred to in paragraph 476.75(1)(d) within the period
  referred to in subsection 476.75(7), but if the contestant does not
  send it to their financial agent within that period then the
  contestant shall provide the Chief Electoral Officer with the
  declaration no later than 14 days after the day on which the
  contestant returns to Canada.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Financial agent relieved of obligation

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection 476.75(1), the financial agent
  need not provide the Chief Electoral Officer with the nomination
  contestant's declaration referred to in paragraph 476.75(1)(d) if, in
  the circumstances set out in subsection (1), the contestant has not
  sent it to the financial agent.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Statement of personal expenses

- **[[476.82]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.82
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A nomination contestant shall,
  within three months after the selection date, send their financial
  agent a written statement in the prescribed form that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} sets out the following:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any travel and living expenses paid
      by the contestant and details of those expenses, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any litigation expenses and
      personal expenses paid by the contestant, details of those
      expenses and an indication of which of them were paid other than
      from the bank account referred to in subsection 476.65(1) and the
      source of the funds used to pay them; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} declares that the contestant did not pay for any
    travel and living expenses, litigation expenses or personal
    expenses.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Supporting documents

  [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} Together with the statement referred to in
  paragraph (1)(a), the nomination contestant shall send their financial
  agent documents evidencing the payment of the expenses referred to in
  the statement.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Death of contestant

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to a nomination
  contestant who dies before the end of the three-month period referred
  to in that subsection without having sent the written statement.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Subsequent payments --- litigation
  expenses

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If, after having sent their financial agent the
  statement referred to in subsection (1), a nomination contestant pays
  a litigation expense other than from the bank account referred to in
  subsection 476.65(1), the contestant shall, as soon as feasible after
  paying it,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} notify their financial agent of the payment;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} inform their financial agent of the amount of the
    expense, the details of the expense and the source of the funds used
    to pay it; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} send their financial agent documents evidencing
    payment of the expense.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
- [2018, c. 31, s. 283](#1043148-1133543){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043148-1133543.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-476.82-20141219.html "Link to previous version of section 476.82"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Corrections, Revisions and Extended Reporting Periods]{.HTitleText4} {#h-208774 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Minor corrections --- Chief Electoral
Officer

- **[[476.83]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.83
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer may
  correct a document referred to in subsection 476.75(1), (10),
  (11), (12) or (15) if the correction does not materially affect its
  substance.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Corrections or revisions at request of
  Chief Electoral Officer

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer may in writing request a
  nomination contestant's financial agent to correct or revise, within a
  specified period, a document referred to in subsection 476.75(1),
  (10), (11), (12) or (15).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deadline for corrections or revisions

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If the Chief Electoral Officer requests the
  correction or revision, the nomination contestant's financial agent
  shall provide the Chief Electoral Officer with the corrected or
  revised version of the document within the specified period.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Extensions --- Chief Electoral Officer

- **[[476.84]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.84
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer, on the
  written application of a nomination contestant or their financial
  agent, shall authorize the extension of a period referred to in
  subsection 476.75(7), (10), (11), (12) or (15), unless he or she is
  satisfied that the financial agent's failure to provide the required
  documents was deliberate or was the result of the financial agent's
  failure to exercise due diligence.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deadline

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The application may be made within the period
  referred to in subsection 476.75(7), (10), (11), (12) or (15) or
  within two weeks after the end of that period.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Corrections or revisions --- Chief
Electoral Officer

- **[[476.85]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.85
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer, on the
  written application of a nomination contestant or their financial
  agent, shall authorize the correction or revision of a document
  referred to in subsection 476.75(1), (10), (11), (12) or (15) if he or
  she is satisfied by the evidence submitted by the applicant that the
  correction or revision is necessary in order for the requirements of
  this Act to be complied with.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application made without delay

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The application shall be made immediately after the
  applicant becomes aware of the need for correction or revision.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deadline for corrections or revisions

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The applicant shall provide the Chief Electoral
  Officer with the corrected or revised version of the document within
  30 days after the day on which the correction or revision is
  authorized or within any extension of that period authorized under
  subsection (4) or (5).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}New deadline

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer, on the written
  application of the applicant made within two weeks after the end of
  the 30-day period referred to in subsection (3), shall authorize the
  extension of that period, unless he or she is satisfied that the
  applicant's failure to provide the corrected or revised version of the
  document was deliberate or was the result of their failure to exercise
  due diligence.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Extension of new deadline

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer, on the written
  application of the applicant made within two weeks after the end of an
  extension authorized under subsection (4) or under this subsection,
  shall authorize the further extension of that period, unless he or she
  is satisfied that the applicant's failure to provide the corrected or
  revised version of the document was deliberate or was the result of
  their failure to exercise due diligence.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Extensions, corrections or revisions ---
judge

- **[[476.86]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.86
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A nomination contestant or their
  financial agent may apply to a judge for an order

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} relieving the financial agent from the obligation
    to comply with a request referred to in subsection 476.83(2);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} authorizing an extension referred to in subsection
    476.84(1); or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} authorizing a correction or revision referred to in
    subsection 476.85(1).

  The applicant shall notify the Chief Electoral Officer that the
  application has been made.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deadline

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The application may be made

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} under paragraph (1)(a), within the specified period
    referred to in subsection 476.83(2) or within the two weeks after
    the end of that period;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} under paragraph (1)(b), within two weeks after, as
    the case may be,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} if an application for an extension is not made to
      the Chief Electoral Officer within the period referred to in
      subsection 476.84(2), the end of the two-week period referred to
      in that subsection,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the rejection of an application for an extension
      made in accordance with section 476.84, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the end of the extended period referred to in
      subsection 476.84(1); or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} under paragraph (1)(c), within two weeks after the
    rejection of an application for a correction or revision made in
    accordance with section 476.85.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Grounds --- relief from compliance

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The judge shall grant an order relieving the
  financial agent from the obligation to comply with a request referred
  to in subsection 476.83(2) if the judge is satisfied by the evidence
  submitted by the applicant that the correction or revision is not
  necessary in order for the requirements of this Act to be complied
  with.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Grounds --- extension

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The judge shall grant an order authorizing an
  extension unless the judge is satisfied that the financial agent's
  failure to provide the required documents was deliberate or was the
  result of their failure to exercise due diligence.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Grounds --- corrections or revisions

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The judge shall grant an order authorizing a
  correction or revision if the judge is satisfied by the evidence
  submitted by the applicant that the correction or revision is
  necessary in order for the requirements of this Act to be complied
  with.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Contents of order

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} An order under subsection (1) may require that the
  applicant satisfy any condition that the judge considers necessary for
  carrying out the purposes of this Act.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Appearance of financial agent before
judge

- **[[476.87]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.87
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A judge dealing with an application
  under section 476.86 or 476.88 who is satisfied that a nomination
  contestant or a financial agent has not provided the documents
  referred to in subsection 476.75(1), (10), (11), (12) or (15) in
  accordance with this Act because of a failure of the financial agent
  or a predecessor of the financial agent shall, by order served
  personally, require the financial agent or that predecessor to appear
  before the judge.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Show cause orders

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The judge shall, unless the financial agent or
  predecessor on his or her appearance shows cause why an order should
  not be issued, order in writing that the agent or predecessor

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} do anything that the judge considers appropriate in
    order to remedy the failure; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} be examined concerning any information that
    pertains to the failure.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Recourse of contestant for fault of
financial agent

**[[476.88]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.88 .sectionLabel}** A nomination
contestant may apply to a judge for an order that relieves the
contestant from any liability or consequence under this or any other Act
of Parliament in relation to an act or omission of the contestant's
financial agent, if the contestant establishes that

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} it occurred without his or her knowledge or
  acquiescence; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} he or she exercised all due diligence to avoid its
  occurrence.

The contestant shall notify the Chief Electoral Officer that the
application has been made.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Destruction of documents --- judge

- **[[476.89]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.89
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A nomination contestant or their
  financial agent may apply to a judge for an order relieving the
  financial agent from the obligation to provide a document referred to
  in subsection 476.75(1), (10), (11), (12) or (15). The applicant shall
  notify the Chief Electoral Officer that the application has been made.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Grounds

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The judge may grant the order only if the judge is
  satisfied that the applicant cannot provide the documents because of
  their destruction by a superior force, including a flood, fire or
  other disaster.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Date of relief

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Act, the applicant is
  relieved from the obligation referred to in subsection (1) on the date
  of the order.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- false or misleading
declaration

**[[476.891]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.891 .sectionLabel}** No nomination
contestant shall send to their financial agent a declaration referred to
in paragraph 476.75(1)(d) that they know or reasonably ought to know is
false or misleading.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 31, s. 284](#1043157-1133547){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043157-1133547.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- false, misleading or
incomplete document

**[[476.9]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.9 .sectionLabel}** No financial agent
of a nomination contestant shall provide the Chief Electoral Officer
with a document referred to in subsection 476.75(1), (10), (11), (12) or
(15) that

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the financial agent knows or ought reasonably to know
  contains a material statement that is false or misleading; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a document referred to in paragraph
  476.75(1)(a), does not substantially set out the information required
  under subsection 476.75(2) and, in the case of a document referred to
  in subsection 476.75(10), (11), (12) or (15), does not substantially
  set out the information required under that subsection.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
- [2018, c. 31, s. 285](#1043159-1133552){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043159-1133552.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-476.9-20141219.html "Link to previous version of section 476.9"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Payment of Audit Expenses]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1133553 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Certificate

- **[[476.901]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.901
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} On receipt of the documents referred
  to in subsection 476.75(1), including the auditor's report, and a copy
  of the auditor's invoice for the report, the Chief Electoral Officer
  shall provide the Receiver General with a certificate that sets out
  the greater of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the amount of the expenses incurred for the audit,
    up to a maximum of the lesser of 3% of the nomination contestant's
    nomination contest expenses and \$1,500, and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} \$250.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Payment

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} On receipt of the certificate, the Receiver General
  shall pay the amount set out in it to the auditor out of the
  Consolidated Revenue Fund.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Inflation adjustment factor

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The \$1,500 amount set out in paragraph (1)(a) and
  the \$250 amount set out in paragraph (1)(b) shall be multiplied by
  the inflation adjustment factor referred to in section 384 that is in
  effect on the selection date.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 31, s. 285](#1043159-1133575){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043159-1133575.html"}
:::

##### [Surplus of Nomination Campaign Funds]{.HTitleText4} {#h-208860 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Surplus of nomination campaign funds

- **[[476.91]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.91
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The surplus amount of nomination
  campaign funds that a nomination contestant receives for a nomination
  contest is the amount by which the sum of the following is more than
  the sum of the contestant's nomination campaign expenses paid from the
  bank account referred to in subsection 476.65(1) and any transfers
  referred to in paragraph 364(5)(a):

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} contributions accepted by the financial agent on
    behalf of the contestant;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} money received from the sale referred to in
    subsection (2); and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} any other amounts received by the contestant for
    their nomination campaign that are required to be deposited into the
    bank account referred to in subsection 476.65(1) and are not
    repayable.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Sale of capital assets

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Before the surplus amount of nomination campaign
  funds is disposed of in accordance with sections 476.92 and 476.93, a
  nomination contestant's financial agent shall sell, at their fair
  market value, any capital assets whose acquisition constitutes a
  nomination campaign expense.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
- [2018, c. 31, s. 286](#1043163-1133584){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043163-1133584.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-476.91-20141219.html "Link to previous version of section 476.91"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of estimated surplus

- **[[476.92]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.92
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If the Chief Electoral Officer
  estimates that a nomination contestant has a surplus of nomination
  campaign funds, the Chief Electoral Officer shall issue a notice of
  the estimated amount of the surplus to the contestant's financial
  agent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Disposal of surplus funds

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The nomination contestant's financial agent shall
  dispose of a surplus of nomination campaign funds within 60 days after
  the day on which they receive the notice of estimated surplus.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Disposal without notice

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If a nomination contestant has a surplus of
  nomination campaign funds but their financial agent has not received a
  notice of estimated surplus, the financial agent shall dispose of the
  surplus within 60 days after the day on which the Chief Electoral
  Officer is provided with the contestant's nomination campaign return.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Method of disposal of surplus

**[[476.93]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.93 .sectionLabel}** A nomination
contestant's financial agent shall dispose of surplus nomination
campaign funds by transferring them to

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the official agent of the candidate endorsed by the
  registered party in the electoral district in which the nomination
  contest was held; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the registered association that held the nomination
  contest or the registered party for whose endorsement the contest was
  held.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of disposal of surplus

- **[[476.94]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476.94
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A nomination contestant's financial
  agent shall, within seven days after disposing of the contestant's
  surplus nomination campaign funds, give the Chief Electoral Officer a
  notice in the prescribed form of the amount and date of the disposal
  and to whom the surplus was transferred.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Publication

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} As soon as feasible after the disposal of a
  nomination contestant's surplus nomination campaign funds, the Chief
  Electoral Officer shall publish the notice in any manner that he or
  she considers appropriate.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

### [DIVISION 5]{.HLabel2}[Candidates]{.HTitleText2} {#h-208887 .Subheading}

#### [SUBDIVISION A]{.HLabel3}[Official Agent and Auditor]{.HTitleText3} {#h-208888 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deeming

**[[477]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-477 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
Division 1 of this Part and this Division, except sections 477.89 to
477.95, a candidate is deemed to have been a candidate from the time
they accept a provision of goods or services under section 364, accept a
transfer of funds under that section, accept a contribution, borrow
money under section 373 or incur an electoral campaign expense within
the meaning of subsection 375(1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 477
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
- [2018, c. 31, s. 287](#1043167-1133587){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043167-1133587.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-477-20141219.html "Link to previous version of section 477"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duty to appoint official agent

- **[[477.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-477.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A candidate shall appoint an
  official agent before accepting a provision of goods or services under
  section 364, accepting a transfer of funds under that section,
  accepting a contribution, borrowing money under section 373 or
  incurring an electoral campaign expense within the meaning of
  subsection 375(1).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Appointment of auditor

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A candidate shall appoint an auditor without delay if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} they accept contributions of \$10,000 or more in
    total;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} they incur electoral campaign expenses of \$10,000
    or more in total; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} they receive 10% or more of the valid votes cast in
    the electoral district in which they are a candidate.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
- [2018, c. 31, s. 288](#1043171-1133596){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043171-1133596.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-477.1-20141219.html "Link to previous version of section 477.1"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Official agent --- ineligibility

**[[477.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-477.2 .sectionLabel}** The following
persons are ineligible to be an official agent:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} an election officer or a member of the staff of a
  returning officer;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a candidate;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} an auditor appointed as required by this Act;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} a person who is not an elector;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} an undischarged bankrupt; and

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} a person who does not have full capacity to enter
  into contracts in the province in which they ordinarily reside.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Auditor --- eligibility

- **[[477.3]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-477.3
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Only the following are eligible to
  be an auditor for a candidate:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a person who is a member in good standing of a
    corporation, association or institute of professional accountants;
    or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a partnership of which every partner is a member in
    good standing of a corporation, association or institute of
    professional accountants.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Auditor --- ineligibility

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The following persons are ineligible to be an
  auditor:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an election officer or a member of the staff of a
    returning officer;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the candidate or any other candidate;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the official agent of the candidate or any other
    candidate;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the chief agent of a registered party or an
    eligible party;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a registered agent of a registered party;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} an electoral district agent of a registered
    association;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} a leadership contestant and their leadership
    campaign agent;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} a nomination contestant and their financial agent;
    and

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a financial agent of a registered third party.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}If partnership appointed as auditor

**[[477.4]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-477.4 .sectionLabel}** Subject to sections
477.2 and 477.3, a person may be appointed as official agent or auditor
for a candidate even if the person is a member of a partnership that has
been appointed in accordance with this Act as an auditor for

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a candidate in an electoral district other than the
  electoral district of the candidate for whom the appointment is being
  made; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a registered party.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Consent

**[[477.41]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-477.41 .sectionLabel}** A candidate shall
obtain from the official agent or auditor, on appointment, their signed
consent to act in that capacity.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Replacement of official agent or auditor

**[[477.42]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-477.42 .sectionLabel}** In the event of
the death, incapacity, resignation or ineligibility of an official agent
or an auditor, or the revocation of the appointment of one, the
candidate shall without delay appoint a replacement.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Only one official agent and auditor

**[[477.43]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-477.43 .sectionLabel}** A candidate shall
have no more than one official agent and one auditor at a time.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- official agents

- **[[477.44]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-477.44
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person who is ineligible to be an
  official agent of a candidate shall act in that capacity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- auditor

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person who is ineligible to be an auditor of a
  candidate shall act in that capacity.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

#### [SUBDIVISION B]{.HLabel3}[Financial Administration of Candidates]{.HTitleText3} {#h-208953 .Subheading}

##### [Powers, Duties and Functions of Official Agent]{.HTitleText4} {#h-208954 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duty of official agent

**[[477.45]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-477.45 .sectionLabel}** A candidate's
official agent is responsible for administering the candidate's
financial transactions for their electoral campaign and for reporting on
those transactions in accordance with this Act.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Bank account

- **[[477.46]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-477.46
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A candidate's official agent shall
  open, for the sole purpose of the candidate's electoral campaign, a
  separate bank account in a Canadian financial institution as defined
  in section 2 of the [Bank Act](/eng/acts/B-1.01), or in an authorized
  foreign bank as defined in that section that is not subject to the
  restrictions and requirements referred to in subsection 524(2) of that
  Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Account holder name

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The account shall name the account holder as follows:
  "(*name of official agent*), official agent".

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deposits into account

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} All of a candidate's financial transactions in
  relation to the candidate's electoral campaign that involve the
  receipt of money are to be deposited to the account unless the
  transaction involves the receipt of the candidate's own funds and
  those funds are used to pay a litigation expense or a personal
  expense.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Payments from account

  [(3.1)]{.lawlabel} All of a candidate's financial transactions in
  relation to the candidate's electoral campaign that involve the
  payment of money are to be paid from the account unless the
  transaction involves the payment out of the candidate's own funds of a
  litigation expense or a personal expense.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Closure of bank account

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} After the election or the withdrawal or death of a
  candidate, the candidate's official agent shall close the account once
  all unpaid claims and surplus electoral funds have been dealt with in
  accordance with this Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Final statement of bank account

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The official agent shall, on closing the account,
  provide the Chief Electoral Officer with the final statement of the
  account.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
- [2018, c. 31, s. 289](#1043175-1133601){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043175-1133601.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-477.46-20141219.html "Link to previous version of section 477.46"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- accepting contributions,
borrowing

- **[[477.47]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-477.47
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person or entity, other than the
  candidate's official agent, shall accept contributions to a
  candidate's electoral campaign or borrow money on the candidate's
  behalf under section 373.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- issuing tax receipts

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person or entity, other than the candidate's
  official agent, shall provide official receipts to contributors of
  monetary contributions to a candidate for the purpose of subsection
  127(3) of the [Income Tax Act](/eng/acts/I-3.3).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- accepting or providing
  goods, services or funds

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} No person or entity, other than the candidate's
  official agent, shall, on behalf of a candidate,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} accept a provision of goods or services, or a
    transfer of funds, if the provision or transfer is permitted under
    section 364; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} provide goods or services, or transfer funds, if
    the provision or transfer is permitted under that section.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- paying electoral
  expenses

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} No person or entity, other than a candidate's
