[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Registry

**[[478.4]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.4 .sectionLabel}** The Chief Electoral
Officer shall maintain a registry of leadership contestants that
contains the information referred to in subsection 478.3(1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2003, c. 19, s. 57
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-478.4-20040101.html "Link to previous version of section 478.4"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[478.41]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.41 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed,
2014, c. 12, s. 86\]]{.Repealed}

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-478.41-20040101.html "Link to previous version of section 478.41"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[478.42]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.42 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed,
2014, c. 12, s. 86\]]{.Repealed}

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-478.42-20040101.html "Link to previous version of section 478.42"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Appointments

- **[[478.5]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.5
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A leadership contestant may appoint
  leadership campaign agents authorized to accept contributions and to
  incur and pay leadership campaign expenses for the contestant. The
  appointment is subject to any terms and conditions that it specifies.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Report of appointment

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Within 30 days after the appointment of a leadership
  campaign agent, the leadership contestant shall provide the Chief
  Electoral Officer with a written report, certified by the contestant's
  financial agent, that includes the leadership campaign agent's name
  and address and any terms and conditions to which the appointment is
  subject. The Chief Electoral Officer shall register that information
  in the registry of leadership contestants.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Agents --- ineligibility

**[[478.6]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.6 .sectionLabel}** The following
persons are ineligible to be the financial agent or a leadership
campaign agent of a leadership contestant:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} an election officer or a member of the staff of a
  returning officer;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a leadership contestant;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} an auditor appointed as required by this Act;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} a person who is not an elector;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} an undischarged bankrupt; and

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} a person who does not have full capacity to enter
  into contracts in the province in which the person ordinarily resides.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Auditor --- eligibility

- **[[478.61]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.61
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Only the following are eligible to
  be an auditor for a leadership contestant:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a person who is a member in good standing of a
    corporation, association or institute of professional accountants;
    or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a partnership of which every partner is a member in
    good standing of a corporation, association or institute of
    professional accountants.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Auditor --- ineligibility

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The following persons are ineligible to be an
  auditor:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an election officer or a member of the staff of a
    returning officer;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the chief agent of a registered party or an
    eligible party, or a registered agent of a registered party;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a candidate or their official agent;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} an electoral district agent of a registered
    association;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a leadership contestant or their leadership
    campaign agent;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a nomination contestant or their financial agent;
    and

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} a financial agent of a registered third party.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}If partnership appointed as auditor

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A person may be appointed as agent for a leadership
  contestant even if the person is a member of a partnership that has
  been appointed as an auditor, in accordance with this Act, for the
  registered party.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
- [2018, c. 31, s. 310(F)](#1043366-1133745){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043366-1133745.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-478.61-20141219.html "Link to previous version of section 478.61"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Consent

**[[478.62]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.62 .sectionLabel}** A leadership
contestant shall obtain from the financial agent or auditor, on
appointment, their signed consent to act in that capacity.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Replacement of financial agent or auditor

**[[478.63]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.63 .sectionLabel}** In the event of
the death, incapacity, resignation or ineligibility of the financial
agent or auditor, or the revocation of the appointment of one, the
leadership contestant shall without delay appoint a replacement.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Only one financial agent and auditor

**[[478.64]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.64 .sectionLabel}** A leadership
contestant shall have no more than one financial agent and one auditor
at a time.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- agents

- **[[478.65]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.65
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person who is ineligible to be a
  financial agent or a leadership campaign agent of a leadership
  contestant shall act in that capacity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- auditor

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person who is ineligible to be an auditor of a
  leadership contestant shall act in that capacity.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Changes in registered information

- **[[478.66]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.66
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Within 30 days after a change in the
  information referred to in subsection 478.3(1) in respect of a
  leadership contestant, the leadership contestant shall report the
  change in writing to the Chief Electoral Officer.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}New auditor or financial agent

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the report involves the replacement of the
  leadership contestant's auditor or financial agent, it shall include a
  copy of the signed consent referred to in section 478.62.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Registration of change

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer shall enter any change in
  the information referred to in this section in the registry of
  leadership contestants.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Withdrawal of leadership contestant

**[[478.67]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.67 .sectionLabel}** A leadership
contestant who withdraws from the leadership contest shall file with the
Chief Electoral Officer a statement in writing to that effect signed by
the contestant and indicating the date of the withdrawal. The Chief
Electoral Officer shall indicate the withdrawal in the registry of
leadership contestants.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of withdrawal of acceptance

**[[478.68]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.68 .sectionLabel}** A registered
party that withdraws its acceptance of a leadership contestant shall
file with the Chief Electoral Officer a statement in writing to that
effect signed by the party's chief agent and indicating the date of the
withdrawal. The Chief Electoral Officer shall register the withdrawal of
acceptance in the registry of leadership contestants.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Relieved of obligations

**[[478.69]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.69 .sectionLabel}** A leadership
contestant who withdraws in accordance with section 478.67 or whose
acceptance is withdrawn in accordance with section 478.68 is relieved of
the obligation to provide returns under section 478.81 for any period
after the withdrawal.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notification of registered party

**[[478.7]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.7 .sectionLabel}** The Chief Electoral
Officer shall, on becoming aware that a leadership contestant of a
registered party has failed to comply with any requirement under this
Division, notify the party accordingly.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

#### [SUBDIVISION B]{.HLabel3}[Financial Administration of Leadership Contestants]{.HTitleText3} {#h-209711 .Subheading}

##### [Powers, Duties and Functions of Financial Agent]{.HTitleText4} {#h-209712 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duty of financial agent

**[[478.71]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.71 .sectionLabel}** A leadership
contestant's financial agent is responsible for administering the
contestant's financial transactions for their leadership campaign and
for reporting on those transactions in accordance with this Act.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Bank account

- **[[478.72]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.72
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A leadership contestant's financial
  agent shall open, for the sole purpose of the contestant's leadership
  campaign, a separate bank account in a Canadian financial institution
  as defined in section 2 of the [Bank Act](/eng/acts/B-1.01), or in an
  authorized foreign bank as defined in that section that is not subject
  to the restrictions and requirements referred to in subsection 524(2)
  of that Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Account holder name

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The account shall name the account holder as follows:
  "(*name of financial agent*), financial agent".

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deposits into account

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} All of a leadership contestant's financial
  transactions in relation to the contestant's leadership campaign that
  involve the receipt of money are to be deposited to the account unless
  the transaction involves the receipt of the contestant's own funds and
  those funds are used to pay a litigation expense or a personal
  expense.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Payments from account

  [(3.1)]{.lawlabel} All of a leadership contestant's financial
  transactions in relation to the contestant's leadership campaign that
  involve the payment of money are to be paid from the account unless
  the transaction involves the payment out of the contestant's own funds
  of a litigation expense or a personal expense.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Closure of bank account

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} After the end of the leadership contest or the
  withdrawal or death of the leadership contestant, the contestant's
  financial agent shall close the account once all unpaid claims and
  surplus leadership campaign funds have been dealt with in accordance
  with this Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Final statement of bank account

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The financial agent shall, on closing the account,
  provide the Chief Electoral Officer with the final statement of the
  account.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
- [2018, c. 31, s. 311](#1043370-1133750){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043370-1133750.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-478.72-20141219.html "Link to previous version of section 478.72"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- accepting contributions,
borrowing

- **[[478.73]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.73
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person or entity, other than a
  leadership campaign agent of a leadership contestant, shall accept
  contributions to the contestant's leadership campaign or borrow money
  on the contestant's behalf under section 373.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- accepting goods,
  services or funds or transferring funds

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person or entity, other than a leadership campaign
  agent of a leadership contestant, shall, on the contestant's behalf,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} accept a provision of goods or services, or a
    transfer of funds, if the provision or transfer is permitted under
    section 364 or 365; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} transfer funds, if the transfer is permitted under
    section 364.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- accepting certain
  transfers of funds

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} No leadership campaign agent of a leadership
  contestant shall, on the contestant's behalf, accept a transfer of
  funds from a registered party or registered association, except the
  transfer by a registered party of an amount out of a directed
  contribution as defined in subsection 365(2).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- paying leadership
  campaign expenses

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} No person or entity, other than a leadership campaign
  agent of a leadership contestant, shall pay the contestant's
  leadership campaign expenses except for

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a litigation expense;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} travel and living expenses;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a personal expense; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a petty expense referred to in section 381.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- incurring leadership
  campaign expenses

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} No person or entity, other than the leadership
  contestant or one of their leadership campaign agents, shall incur the
  contestant's leadership campaign expenses.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- paying contestant's
  personal expenses, etc.

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} No person or entity, other than the leadership
  contestant or their financial agent, shall pay the contestant's
  expenses referred to in any of paragraphs 4(a) to (c).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
- [2018, c. 31, s. 312](#1043383-1133759){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043383-1133759.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-478.73-20141219.html "Link to previous version of section 478.73"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Recovery of Claims for Debts]{.HTitleText4} {#h-209747 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Claim for payment

**[[478.74]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.74 .sectionLabel}** A person who has
a claim to be paid for a leadership campaign expense shall send the
invoice or other document evidencing the claim to the leadership
contestant's financial agent or, if there is no financial agent, to the
leadership contestant.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Payment within three years

- **[[478.75]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.75
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a claim for a leadership campaign
  expense is evidenced by an invoice or other document that has been
  sent under section 478.74, or if a claim for repayment of a loan is
  made to the leadership contestant under section 373, the claim shall
  be paid within three years after the day on which the leadership
  contest ends.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- payment without
  authorization

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} No leadership contestant and no financial agent of a
  leadership contestant shall pay a claim referred to in subsection (1)
  after the expiry of the three-year period referred to in that
  subsection unless authorized to do so under section 478.77 or 478.78,
  or ordered to do so as a result of proceedings commenced under section
  478.79.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Unenforceable contracts

**[[478.76]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.76 .sectionLabel}** A contract in
relation to a leadership campaign is not enforceable against the
leadership contestant unless it was entered into by the contestant
personally or by one of the contestant's leadership campaign agents.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Irregular claims or payments --- Chief
Electoral Officer

- **[[478.77]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.77
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} On the written application of a
  person who has a claim to be paid for a leadership campaign expense in
  relation to a leadership contestant or to be paid for a loan made to
  the contestant under section 373, or on the written application of the
  contestant's financial agent or the contestant, the Chief Electoral
  Officer may, on being satisfied that there are reasonable grounds for
  so doing, in writing authorize the contestant's financial agent to pay
  the amount claimed if the payment of the expense or the repayment of
  the loan was not made within the three-year period referred to in
  subsection 478.75(1).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Conditions

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer may impose any term or
  condition that he or she considers appropriate on a payment authorized
  under subsection (1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Irregular claims or payments --- judge

**[[478.78]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.78 .sectionLabel}** On the
application of a person who has a claim to be paid for a leadership
campaign expense in relation to a leadership contestant or to be paid
for a loan made to the contestant under section 373, or on the
application of the contestant's financial agent or the contestant, a
judge may, on being satisfied that there are reasonable grounds for so
doing, by order authorize the contestant's financial agent to pay the
amount claimed if

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the applicant establishes that an authorization under
  subsection 478.77(1) has been refused and that the payment has not
  been made within the three-year period referred to in subsection
  478.75(1); or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the amount claimed has not been paid in accordance
  with an authorization obtained under subsection 478.77(1) and the
  applicant establishes their inability to comply with the authorization
  for reasons beyond their control.

The applicant shall notify the Chief Electoral Officer that the
application has been made.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Proceedings to recover payment

**[[478.79]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.79 .sectionLabel}** A person who has
sent an invoice or other document evidencing a claim under section
478.74, or has a claim for repayment of a loan made to a leadership
contestant under section 373, may commence proceedings in a court of
competent jurisdiction to recover any unpaid amount

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} at any time, if the leadership contestant or their
  financial agent refuses to pay that amount or disputes that it is
  payable; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} after the end of the three-year period referred to in
  subsection 478.75(1) or any extension of that period authorized under
  subsection 478.77(1) or section 478.78, in any other case.

The leadership contestant shall notify the Chief Electoral Officer that
the proceedings have been commenced.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

##### [Leadership Campaign Return]{.HTitleText4} {#h-209784 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Leadership campaign return

- **[[478.8]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.8
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A leadership contestant's financial
  agent shall provide the Chief Electoral Officer with the following in
  respect of a leadership contest:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a leadership campaign return, in the prescribed
    form, on the financing and leadership campaign expenses for the
    leadership campaign;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the auditor's report on the return, if one is
    required under subsection 478.83(1);

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a declaration in the prescribed form by the
    financial agent that the return is complete and accurate; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a declaration in the prescribed form by the
    leadership contestant that the return is complete and accurate.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Contents of return

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The leadership campaign return shall set out

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a statement of leadership contest expenses;

  - [(a.1)]{.lawlabel} a statement of litigation expenses that includes
    an indication of which of those expenses were paid other than from
    the bank account referred to in subsection 478.72(1) and the source
    of the funds used to pay them;

  - [(a.2)]{.lawlabel} a statement of travel and living expenses;

  - [(a.3)]{.lawlabel} a statement of personal expenses that includes an
    indication of which of those expenses were paid other than from the
    bank account referred to in subsection 478.72(1) and the source of
    the funds used to pay them;

  - [(a.4)]{.lawlabel} a statement of leadership campaign expenses,
    other than the expenses referred to in paragraphs (a) to (a.3);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a statement of claims that are the subject of
    proceedings under section 478.79;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a statement of unpaid claims, including those
    resulting from loans made to the leadership contestant under section
    373;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the terms and conditions of each
    loan made to the leadership contestant under section 373, including
    the amount of the loan, the interest rate, the lender's name and
    address, the dates and amounts of repayments of principal and
    payments of interest, the unpaid principal remaining at the end of
    each calendar year and, if there is a guarantor, the guarantor's
    name and address and the amount guaranteed;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the total amount of contributions received by the
    leadership contestant;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the number of contributors;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of each contributor who made
    contributions of a total amount of more than \$200 to the leadership
    contestant, that total amount, as well as the amount of each of
    those contributions and the date on which the contestant received
    it;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of each contributor who made a
    contribution that includes a directed contribution as defined in
    subsection 365(2) out of which an amount has been transferred by the
    party to the contestant, the amount of the contribution, the amount
    of the directed contribution and the amount transferred, as well as
    the dates of the receipt of the contribution and of the transfer;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the funds transferred by the
    leadership contestant to a registered party or a registered
    association;

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the commercial value of goods or
    services provided and of funds transferred to the leadership
    contestant by a registered party or a registered association; and

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} a statement of contributions received but returned
    in whole or in part to the contributors or otherwise dealt with in
    accordance with this Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Supporting documents

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Together with the leadership campaign return, the
  leadership contestant's financial agent shall provide the Chief
  Electoral Officer with documents evidencing expenses set out in the
  return, including bank statements, deposit slips, cancelled cheques
  and the contestant's written statement referred to in subsection
  478.85(1).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Additional supporting documents

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} If the Chief Electoral Officer is of the opinion that
  the documents provided under subsection (3) are not sufficient, he or
  she may require the financial agent to provide by a specified date any
  additional documents that are necessary for the financial agent to
  comply with that subsection.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Report

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} If there is any amendment to the information in a
  statement referred to in paragraph (2)(d), including with respect to
  the giving of a guarantee or suretyship in respect of the loan, then
  the leadership contestant's financial agent shall without delay
  provide the Chief Electoral Officer with a report on the amendment in
  the prescribed form.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Publication

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer shall, in the manner that
  he or she considers appropriate, publish the information in a
  statement made under paragraph (2)(d) and any report provided under
  subsection (5) as soon as feasible after receiving the information or
  report.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Period for providing documents

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} The documents referred to in subsection (1) shall be
  provided to the Chief Electoral Officer within six months after the
  end of the leadership contest.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Declaration of leadership contestant

  [(8)]{.lawlabel} A leadership contestant shall, within six months
  after the end of the leadership contest, send their financial agent
  the declaration referred to in paragraph (1)(d).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Death of leadership contestant

  [(9)]{.lawlabel} If a leadership contestant dies without having sent
  the declaration within the period referred to in subsection (8),

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} they are deemed to have sent the declaration in
    accordance with that subsection;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the financial agent is deemed to have provided the
    declaration to the Chief Electoral Officer in accordance with
    subsection (1); and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the Chief Electoral Officer is deemed to have
    received the declaration for the purpose of section 478.931.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Payment of unpaid claims

  [(10)]{.lawlabel} If a claim --- including one resulting from a loan
  --- is paid in full after the return under paragraph (1)(a) is
  provided to the Chief Electoral Officer, the leadership contestant's
  financial agent shall provide the Chief Electoral Officer with a
  report in the prescribed form on the payment of the claim within 30
  days after the day on which the payment is made, including information
  indicating the source of the funds used to pay the claim.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}First update

  [(11)]{.lawlabel} The leadership contestant's financial agent shall
  provide the Chief Electoral Officer with an updated version of the
  statement of unpaid claims referred to in paragraph (2)(c), as of the
  day that is 18 months after the end of the leadership contest, within
  the period that begins 18 months after the end of the leadership
  contest and ends 19 months after the end of the leadership contest.
  The updated version shall include the following information concerning
  the unpaid amount of a claim, including one resulting from a loan:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} whether any part of the unpaid amount is disputed
    and, if so, what steps the parties have taken to resolve the
    dispute;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} whether the claim is the subject of proceedings
    under section 478.79;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} whether the unpaid amount of a loan is the subject
    of proceedings to secure its payment, or of a dispute as to the
    amount that was to be paid or the amount that remains unpaid;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} whether the parties have agreed on a repayment
    schedule and, if so, whether repayments are being made according to
    the schedule;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} whether the unpaid amount has been written off by
    the creditor as an uncollectable debt in accordance with the
    creditor's normal accounting practices; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} any other relevant information that could help
    explain why the amount is unpaid.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Second update

  [(12)]{.lawlabel} The leadership contestant's financial agent shall
  provide the Chief Electoral Officer with an updated version of the
  statement of unpaid claims referred to in paragraph (2)(c), as of the
  day that is 36 months after the end of the leadership contest, within
  the period that begins 36 months after the end of the leadership
  contest and ends 37 months after the end of the leadership contest.
  The updated version shall include the information referred to in
  paragraphs (11)(a) to (f).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Supporting documents

  [(13)]{.lawlabel} Together with the updated versions of the statement
  of unpaid claims referred to in subsections (11) and (12), the
  leadership contestant's financial agent shall provide the Chief
  Electoral Officer with documents evidencing the matters referred to in
  paragraphs (11)(a) to (f), including, if paragraph (11)(d) applies, a
  copy of the repayment schedule.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Additional supporting documents

  [(14)]{.lawlabel} If the Chief Electoral Officer is of the opinion
  that the documents provided under subsection (13) are not sufficient,
  he or she may require the financial agent to provide by a specified
  date any additional documents that are necessary for the financial
  agent to comply with that subsection.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Irregular claims and payments

  [(15)]{.lawlabel} The leadership contestant's financial agent shall
  provide the Chief Electoral Officer with a report in the prescribed
  form on the payment of a claim that was subject to an authorization to
  pay under section 478.77 or 478.78 or an order to pay resulting from
  proceedings commenced under section 478.79. The financial agent shall
  provide the report within 30 days after the day on which the payment
  is made and shall include in it information indicating the source of
  the funds used to pay the claim.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
- 2018, c. 20, s. 8
- [2018, c. 31, ss. 313, 399](#1043407-1133770){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043407-1133770.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-478.8-20181221.html "Link to previous version of section 478.8"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Return on contributions

- **[[478.81]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.81
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A leadership contestant's financial
  agent shall, for the period beginning on the first day of the
  leadership contest and ending on the day that is four weeks before the
  end of the leadership contest, provide the Chief Electoral Officer
  with a return that includes the information required under paragraphs
  478.8(2)(d) to (k) if the leadership contestant has, during that
  period, accepted contributions of more than \$10,000 in total or
  incurred leadership campaign expenses of more than \$10,000 in total.
  The financial agent shall provide the return within one week after the
  end of that period.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Second return

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The leadership contestant's financial agent shall
  also provide the Chief Electoral Officer with such a return for the
  period beginning on the first day after the end of the period referred
  to in subsection (1) and ending on the day that is one week before the
  end of the leadership contest. The financial agent shall provide the
  return no later than two days before the end of the leadership
  contest.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Return on contributions

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The financial agent of a leadership contestant who
  attains the threshold for contributions or expenses as described in
  subsection (1) after the period referred to in that subsection shall
  provide the Chief Electoral Officer with a return that includes the
  information referred to in that subsection for the period beginning on
  the first day of the leadership contest and ending on the day that is
  one week before the end of the leadership contest. The financial agent
  shall provide the return no later than two days before the end of the
  leadership contest.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}When contributions forwarded to Receiver
General

**[[478.82]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.82 .sectionLabel}** If the name of
the contributor of a contribution of more than \$20 to a leadership
contestant, or the name or address of a contributor who has made
contributions of a total amount of more than \$200 to a leadership
contestant, is not known, the leadership contestant's financial agent
shall, without delay, pay an amount of money equal to the value of the
contribution to the Chief Electoral Officer, who shall forward it to the
Receiver General.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Auditor's report

- **[[478.83]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.83
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} As soon as feasible after the end of
  a leadership contest, the auditor of a leadership contestant who has
  accepted contributions of \$10,000 or more in total or incurred
  leadership campaign expenses of \$10,000 or more in total shall report
  to the contestant's financial agent on the leadership campaign return
  for that contest and shall, in accordance with generally accepted
  auditing standards, make any examination that will enable the auditor
  to give an opinion in the report as to whether the return presents
  fairly the information contained in the financial records on which it
  is based.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Statement

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The auditor shall include in the report any statement
  that the auditor considers necessary if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the return does not present fairly the information
    contained in the financial records on which it is based;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the auditor has not received all the information
    and explanations that the auditor required; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} based on the examination, it appears that the
    financial agent has not kept proper financial records.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Right of access

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The auditor shall have access at any reasonable time
  to all of the leadership contestant's documents, and may require the
  contestant and their financial agent to provide any information or
  explanation that, in the auditor's opinion, may be necessary to enable
  the auditor to prepare the report.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Ineligible to prepare report

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} No person referred to in subsection 478.61(2) who is
  a partner or an associate of a leadership contestant's auditor or who
  is an employee of that auditor, or of the firm in which that auditor
  is a partner or associate, shall participate, other than in the manner
  referred to in subsection (3), in the preparation of the auditor's
  report.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
- [2018, c. 31, s. 314](#1043422-1133772){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043422-1133772.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-478.83-20141219.html "Link to previous version of section 478.83"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Leadership contestants outside Canada

- **[[478.84]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.84
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection 478.8(7), a
  leadership contestant who is outside Canada when the documents
  referred to in paragraphs 478.8(1)(a) to (c) are provided to the Chief
  Electoral Officer need not send their financial agent the declaration
  referred to in paragraph 478.8(1)(d) within the period referred to in
  subsection 478.8(7), but if the contestant does not send it to their
  financial agent within that period then the contestant shall provide
  the Chief Electoral Officer with the declaration no later than 14 days
  after the day on which the contestant returns to Canada.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Financial agent relieved of obligation

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection 478.8(1), the financial agent need
  not provide the Chief Electoral Officer with the leadership
  contestant's declaration referred to in paragraph 478.8(1)(d) if, in
  the circumstances set out in subsection (1), the contestant has not
  sent it to the financial agent.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Statement of personal expenses

- **[[478.85]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.85
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A leadership contestant shall,
  within five months after the end of the leadership contest, send their
  financial agent a written statement in the prescribed form that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} sets out the following:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any travel and living expenses paid
      by the contestant and details of those expenses, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any litigation expenses and
      personal expenses paid by the contestant, details of those
      expenses and an indication of which of them were paid other than
      from the bank account referred to in subsection 478.72(1) and the
      source of the funds used to pay them; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} declares that the contestant did not pay for any
    travel and living expenses, litigation expenses or personal
    expenses.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Supporting documents

  [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} Together with the statement referred to in
  paragraph (1)(a), the leadership contestant shall send their financial
  agent documents evidencing the payment of the expenses referred to in
  the statement.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Death of contestant

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to a leadership
  contestant who dies before the end of the five-month period referred
  to in that subsection without having sent the written statement.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Subsequent payments --- litigation
  expenses

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If, after having sent their financial agent the
  statement referred to in subsection (1), a leadership contestant pays
  a litigation expense other than from the bank account referred to in
  subsection 478.72(1), the contestant shall, as soon as feasible after
  paying it,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} notify their financial agent of the payment;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} inform their financial agent of the amount of the
    expense, the details of the expense and the source of the funds used
    to pay it; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} send their financial agent documents evidencing
    payment of the expense.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
- [2018, c. 31, s. 315](#1043435-1133784){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043435-1133784.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-478.85-20141219.html "Link to previous version of section 478.85"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Corrections, Revisions and Extended Reporting Periods]{.HTitleText4} {#h-209885 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Minor corrections --- Chief Electoral
Officer

- **[[478.86]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.86
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer may
  correct a document referred to in subsection 478.8(1), (10),
  (11), (12) or (15) if the correction does not materially affect its
  substance.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Corrections or revisions at request of
  Chief Electoral Officer

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer may in writing request a
  leadership contestant's financial agent to correct or revise, within a
  specified period, a document referred to in subsection 478.8(1), (10),
  (11), (12) or (15).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deadline for correction or revision

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If the Chief Electoral Officer requests the
  correction or revision, the leadership contestant's financial agent
  shall provide the Chief Electoral Officer with the corrected or
  revised version of the document within the specified period.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Extensions --- Chief Electoral Officer

- **[[478.87]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.87
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer, on the
  written application of a leadership contestant or their financial
  agent, shall authorize the extension of a period referred to in
  subsection 478.8(7), (10), (11), (12) or (15), unless he or she is
  satisfied that the financial agent's failure to provide the required
  documents was deliberate or was the result of the financial agent's
  failure to exercise due diligence.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deadline

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The application may be made within the period
  referred to in subsection 478.8(7), (10), (11), (12) or (15) or within
  two weeks after the end of that period.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Corrections or revisions --- Chief
Electoral Officer

- **[[478.88]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.88
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer, on the
  written application of a leadership contestant or their financial
  agent, shall authorize the correction or revision of a document
  referred to in subsection 478.8(1), (10), (11), (12) or (15) if he or
  she is satisfied by the evidence submitted by the applicant that the
  correction or revision is necessary in order for the requirements of
  this Act to be complied with.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application made without delay

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The application shall be made immediately after the
  applicant becomes aware of the need for correction or revision.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deadline for correction or revision

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The applicant shall provide the Chief Electoral
  Officer with the corrected or revised version of the document within
  30 days after the day on which the correction or revision is
  authorized or within any extension of that period authorized under
  subsection (4) or (5).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}New deadline

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer, on the written
  application of the applicant made within two weeks after the end of
  the 30-day period referred to in subsection (3), shall authorize the
  extension of that period, unless he or she is satisfied that the
  applicant's failure to provide the corrected or revised version of the
  document was deliberate or was the result of the applicant's failure
  to exercise due diligence.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Extension of new deadline

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The Chief Electoral Officer, on the written
  application of the applicant made within two weeks after the end of an
  extension authorized under subsection (4) or under this subsection,
  shall authorize the further extension of that period, unless he or she
  is satisfied that the applicant's failure to provide the corrected or
  revised version of the document was deliberate or was the result of
  the applicant's failure to exercise due diligence.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Extensions, corrections or revisions ---
judge

- **[[478.89]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.89
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A leadership contestant or their
  financial agent may apply to a judge for an order

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} relieving the financial agent from the obligation
    to comply with a request referred to in subsection 478.86(2);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} authorizing an extension referred to in subsection
    478.87(1); or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} authorizing a correction or revision referred to in
    subsection 478.88(1).

  The applicant shall notify the Chief Electoral Officer that the
  application has been made.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deadline

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The application may be made

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} under paragraph (1)(a), within the specified period
    referred to in subsection 478.86(2) or within the two weeks after
    the end of that period;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} under paragraph (1)(b), within two weeks after, as
    the case may be,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} if an application for an extension is not made to
      the Chief Electoral Officer within the period referred to in
      subsection 478.87(2), the end of the two-week period referred to
      in that subsection,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the rejection of an application for an extension
      made in accordance with section 478.87, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the end of the extended period referred to in
      subsection 478.87(1); or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} under paragraph (1)(c), within two weeks after the
    rejection of an application for a correction or revision made in
    accordance with section 478.88.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Grounds --- relief from compliance

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The judge shall grant an order relieving the
  financial agent from the obligation to comply with a request referred
  to in subsection 478.86(2) if the judge is satisfied by the evidence
  submitted by the applicant that the correction or revision is not
  necessary in order for the requirements of this Act to be complied
  with.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Grounds --- extension

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The judge shall grant an order authorizing an
  extension unless the judge is satisfied that the financial agent's
  failure to provide the required documents was deliberate or was the
  result of the financial agent's failure to exercise due diligence.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Grounds --- corrections or revisions

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The judge shall grant an order authorizing a
  correction or revision if the judge is satisfied by the evidence
  submitted by the applicant that the correction or revision is
  necessary in order for the requirements of this Act to be complied
  with.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Contents of order

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} An order under subsection (1) may require that the
  applicant satisfy any condition that the judge considers necessary for
  carrying out the purposes of this Act.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Appearance of financial agent before
judge

- **[[478.9]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.9
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A judge dealing with an application
  under section 478.89 or 478.91 who is satisfied that a leadership
  contestant or a financial agent has not provided the documents
  referred to in subsection 478.8(1), (10), (11), (12) or (15) in
  accordance with this Act because of a failure of the financial agent
  or a predecessor of the financial agent shall, by order served
  personally, require the financial agent or that predecessor to appear
  before the judge.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Show cause orders

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The judge shall, unless the financial agent or
  predecessor on his or her appearance shows cause why an order should
  not be issued, order in writing that the agent of predecessor

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} do anything that the judge considers appropriate in
    order to remedy the failure; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} be examined concerning any information that
    pertains to the failure.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Recourse of contestant for fault of
financial agent

**[[478.91]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.91 .sectionLabel}** A leadership
contestant may apply to a judge for an order that relieves the
contestant from any liability or consequence under this or any other Act
of Parliament in relation to an act or omission of the contestant's
financial agent, if the contestant establishes that

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} it occurred without his or her knowledge or
  acquiescence; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} he or she exercised all due diligence to avoid its
  occurrence.

The contestant shall notify the Chief Electoral Officer that the
application has been made.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Destruction of documents --- judge

- **[[478.92]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.92
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A leadership contestant or their
  financial agent may apply to a judge for an order relieving the
  financial agent from the obligation to provide a document referred to
  in subsection 478.8(1), (10), (11), (12) or (15). The applicant shall
  notify the Chief Electoral Officer that the application has been made.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Grounds

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The judge may grant the order only if the judge is
  satisfied that the applicant cannot provide the documents because of
  their destruction by a superior force, including a flood, fire or
  other disaster.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Date of relief

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Act, the applicant is
  relieved from the obligation referred to in subsection (1) on the date
  of the order.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- false or misleading
declaration

**[[478.921]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.921 .sectionLabel}** No leadership
contestant shall send to their financial agent a declaration referred to
in paragraph 478.8(1)(d) that they know or ought reasonably to know is
false or misleading.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 31, s. 316](#1043444-1133788){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043444-1133788.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- false, misleading or
incomplete document

**[[478.93]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.93 .sectionLabel}** No financial
agent of a leadership contestant shall provide the Chief Electoral
Officer with a document referred to in subsection 478.8(1), (10), (11),
(12) or (15) that

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the financial agent knows or ought reasonably to know
  contains a material statement that is false or misleading; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a document referred to in paragraph
  478.8(1)(a), does not substantially set out the information required
  under subsection 478.8(2) and, in the case of a document referred to
  in subsection 478.8(10), (11), (12) or (15), does not substantially
  set out the information required under that subsection.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
- [2018, c. 31, s. 317](#1043446-1133793){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043446-1133793.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-478.93-20141219.html "Link to previous version of section 478.93"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Payment of Audit Expenses]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1133794 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Certificate

- **[[478.931]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.931
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} On receipt of the documents referred
  to in subsection 478.8(1), including the auditor's report, and a copy
  of the auditor's invoice for the report, the Chief Electoral Officer
  shall provide the Receiver General with a certificate that sets out
  the greater of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the amount of the expenses incurred for the audit,
    up to a maximum of the lesser of 3% of the leadership contestant's
    leadership contest expenses and \$1,500, and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} \$250.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Payment

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} On receipt of the certificate, the Receiver General
  shall pay the amount set out in it to the auditor out of the
  Consolidated Revenue Fund.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Inflation adjustment factor

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The \$1,500 amount set out in paragraph (1)(a) and
  the \$250 amount set out in paragraph (1)(b) shall be multiplied by
  the inflation adjustment factor referred to in section 384 that is in
  effect on the day on which the leadership contest ends.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 31, s. 318](#1043450-1133816){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043450-1133816.html"}
:::

##### [Surplus of Leadership Campaign Funds]{.HTitleText4} {#h-209971 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Surplus of leadership campaign funds

- **[[478.94]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.94
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The surplus amount of leadership
  campaign funds that a leadership contestant receives for a leadership
  contest is the amount by which the sum of the following is more than
  the sum of the contestant's leadership campaign expenses paid from the
  bank account referred to in subsection 478.72(1) and any transfers
  referred to in paragraph 364(5)(b):

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} contributions accepted by the leadership campaign
    agents on behalf of the contestant;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} money received from the sale referred to in
    subsection (2);

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} amounts referred to in subsection 365(3); and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} any other amounts received by the contestant for
    their leadership campaign that are required to be deposited into the
    bank account referred to in subsection 478.72(1) and are not
    repayable.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Sale of capital assets

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Before the surplus amount of leadership campaign
  funds is disposed of in accordance with sections 478.95 and 478.96, a
  leadership contestant's financial agent shall sell, at their fair
  market value, any capital assets whose acquisition constitutes a
  leadership campaign expense.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
- [2018, c. 31, s. 319](#1043452-1133826){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043452-1133826.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-478.94-20141219.html "Link to previous version of section 478.94"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of estimated surplus

- **[[478.95]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.95
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If the Chief Electoral Officer
  estimates that a leadership contestant has a surplus of leadership
  campaign funds, the Chief Electoral Officer shall issue a notice of
  the estimated amount of the surplus to the contestant's financial
  agent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Disposal of surplus funds

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The leadership contestant's financial agent shall
  dispose of a surplus of leadership campaign funds within 60 days after
  the day on which they receive the notice of estimated surplus.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Disposal without notice

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If a leadership contestant has a surplus of
  leadership campaign funds but their financial agent has not received a
  notice of estimated surplus, the financial agent shall dispose of the
  surplus within 60 days after the day on which the Chief Electoral
  Officer is provided with the contestant's leadership campaign return.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Method of disposal of surplus

**[[478.96]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.96 .sectionLabel}** The leadership
contestant's financial agent shall dispose of surplus leadership
campaign funds by transferring them to the registered party that is
holding the leadership contest or a registered association of that
party.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of disposal of surplus

- **[[478.97]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478.97
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A leadership contestant's financial
  agent shall, within seven days after disposing of the contestant's
  surplus leadership campaign funds, give the Chief Electoral Officer a
  notice in the prescribed form of the amount and date of the disposal
  and to whom the surplus was transferred.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Publication

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} As soon as feasible after the disposal of a
  leadership contestant's surplus leadership campaign funds, the Chief
  Electoral Officer shall publish the notice in any manner that he or
  she considers appropriate.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 86
:::

## [PART 19]{.HLabel1}[Enforcement]{.HTitleText1} {#h-209996 .Part}

### [Peace and Good Order at Elections]{.HTitleText2} {#h-209997 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duty to maintain order

- **[[479]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-479
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every returning officer is
  responsible for maintaining order in his or her office during voting
  in accordance with Division 4 of Part 11.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duty to maintain order

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Every election officer is responsible for maintaining
  order during voting hours at any place where voting takes place in
  accordance with Part 9 or 10.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Order to leave

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} In performing his or her duty under subsection (1) or
  (2), an election officer may order a person to leave the returning
  officer's office or other place where the vote is taking place if the
  person is committing --- or the officer believes on reasonable grounds
  that the person has committed --- in the office or place an offence
  under this Act, any other Act of Parliament or any regulation made
  under any other Act of Parliament that threatens the maintenance of
  order.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Order must be obeyed

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Every person in respect of whom an order is made to
  leave an office or place must obey it without delay.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2018, c. 31, s. 320\]]{.Repealed}

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2018, c. 31, s. 320\]]{.Repealed}

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Removal of material

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} If a returning officer or other election officer
  believes on reasonable grounds that a person has contravened paragraph
  166(1)(a) or (b), the officer may cause any material that they believe
  on reasonable grounds was used in contravention of that paragraph to
  be removed from, in the case of a returning officer, his or her office
  or, in the case of any other election officer, the polling station.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Peace officer protection

  [(8)]{.lawlabel} Every election officer has, while exercising their
  powers or performing their duties under this section, all the
  protection that a peace officer has by law.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 479
- [2018, c. 31, s. 320](#1043463-1133839){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043463-1133839.html"}
:::

### [Offences]{.HTitleText2} {#h-210017 .Subheading}

#### [General Provisions]{.HTitleText3} {#h-210018 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Obstruction, etc., of electoral process

- **[[480]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-480
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every person is guilty of an offence
  who, with the intention of delaying or obstructing the electoral
  process, contravenes this Act, otherwise than by committing an offence
  under subsection (2) or section 480.1, 481, 482 or 482.1 or
  contravening a provision referred to in any of sections 484 to 499.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Public meetings

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Every person is guilty of an offence who, at any time
  between the issue of a writ and the day after polling day at the
  election, acts, incites others to act or conspires to act in a
  disorderly manner with the intention of preventing the transaction of
  the business of a public meeting called for the purposes of the
  election.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 480
- [2018, c. 31, s. 321](#1043470-1133843){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043470-1133843.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-480-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 480"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Impersonation

- **[[480.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-480.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every person is guilty of an offence
  who, with intent to mislead, falsely represents themselves to be, or
  causes anyone to falsely represent themselves to be,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the Chief Electoral Officer, a member of the Chief
    Electoral Officer's staff or a person who is authorized to act on
    the Chief Electoral Officer's behalf;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an election officer or a person who is authorized
    to act on an election officer's behalf;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a person who is authorized to act on behalf of the
    Office of the Chief Electoral Officer;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a person who is authorized to act on behalf of a
    registered party or a registered association; or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a candidate or a person who is authorized to act on
    a candidate's behalf.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A person does not commit an offence under
  subsection (1) if they establish that the representation was
  manifestly for the purpose of parody or satire.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 88
- [2018, c. 31, s. 322](#1043472-1135441){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043472-1135441.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-480.1-20140619.html "Link to previous version of section 480.1"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Misleading publications

- **[[481]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-481
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every person or entity is guilty of
  an offence that, during an election period, distributes, transmits or
  publishes any material, regardless of its form, that purports to be
  made, distributed, transmitted or published by or under the authority
  of the Chief Electoral Officer, or a returning officer, political
  party, candidate or prospective candidate if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the person or entity was not authorized by the
    Chief Electoral Officer or that returning officer, political party,
    candidate or prospective candidate to distribute, transmit or
    publish it; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the person or entity distributes, transmits or
    publishes it with the intent of misleading the public into believing
    that it was made, distributed, transmitted or published by or under
    the authority of the Chief Electoral Officer, or that returning
    officer, political party, candidate or prospective candidate.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Factors

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} In determining whether a person or entity has
  committed an offence under subsection (1) the court may consider
  whether the material included the use of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a name, logo, social media account identifier,
    username or domain name that is distinctive and commonly associated
    with the Chief Electoral Officer, a returning officer, or the
    political party, candidate or prospective candidate, as the case may
    be; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the name, voice, image or signature of the Chief
    Electoral Officer, a returning officer, or the candidate or
    prospective candidate or of a public figure who is associated with
    the political party.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception --- parody or satire

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A person or entity does not commit an offence under
  subsection (1) if they establish that the material was manifestly
  distributed, transmitted or published for the purpose of parody or
  satire.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 481
- [2018, c. 31, s. 323](#1043476-1133874){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043476-1133874.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-481-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 481"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Unauthorized use of computer

- **[[482]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-482
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every person or entity is guilty of
  an offence that, fraudulently, and with the intention of affecting the
  results of an election,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} by means of an electro-magnetic, acoustic,
    mechanical or other device, intercepts or causes to be intercepted,
    directly or indirectly, any function of a computer system;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} uses or causes to be used, directly or indirectly,
    a computer system with intent to

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} commit an offence under paragraph (a),

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} destroy or alter computer data,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} render computer data meaningless, useless or
      ineffective,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} obstruct, interrupt or interfere with the lawful
      use of computer data, or

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} obstruct, interrupt or interfere with a person or
      entity in the lawful use of computer data or deny access to
      computer data to a person or entity that is entitled to access to
      it;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} uses, possesses or traffics in, or permits another
    person or entity to have access to, a computer password that would
    enable a person or entity to commit an offence under paragraph (a)
    or (b); or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} attempts to commit any offence referred to in
    paragraphs (a) to (c).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Words and expressions

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Words and expressions used in subsection (1) have the
  same meaning as in subsection 342.1(2) of the [Criminal
  Code](/eng/acts/C-46).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2000, c. 9, s. 482
- [2018, c. 31, s. 323](#1043476-1133891){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1043476-1133891.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-482-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 482"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Obstruction, etc.

**[[482.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-482.1 .sectionLabel}** Every person is
guilty of an offence who obstructs or hinders --- or knowingly makes,
either orally or in writing, a false or misleading statement to --- the
Commissioner of Canada Elections or any person acting under his or her
direction while the Commissioner or the person acting under his or her
direction is exercising or performing powers, duties or functions
conferred or imposed on the Commissioner under this Act.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2014, c. 12, s. 89
:::

**[[483]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-483 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed, 2018, c.
31, s. 324\]]{.Repealed}

#### [Offences under Part 3 (Election Officers)]{.HTitleText3} {#h-210051 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Strict liability offences --- summary
conviction

- **[[484]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-484
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every former election officer who
  contravenes paragraph 43(c) (failure to return election documents and
  election materials) is guilty of an offence.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Offences requiring intent --- summary
  conviction

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Every person is guilty of an offence who

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} being a returning officer, wilfully contravenes
    subsection 24(3) (failure to take promptly any necessary election
    proceedings);

  - [(a.1)]{.lawlabel} being an election officer, knowingly contravenes
    section 39 (failure to exercise or perform the powers or duties
    assigned by a returning officer in accordance with the Chief
    Electoral Officer's instructions); or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} contravenes subsection 43.1(1) (refusal to give
    access to building or gated community).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Offences requiring intent --- dual
  procedure

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Every person is guilty of an offence who

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} contravenes subsection 22(6) (acting as election
    officer knowing requirements not met);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} knowingly contravenes subsection 23(2)
    (communication of information or use of personal information for
    unauthorized purpose);

  - [(b.1)]{.lawlabel} being a field liaison officer, contravenes
    subsection 23.2(8) (engaging in politically partisan conduct);

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} being a returning officer, contravenes subsection
    24(6) (engaging in politically partisan conduct);

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} being a returning officer or assistant returning
    officer, wilfully contravenes section 31 (acting in another
    capacity);

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} contravenes paragraph 43(a) (obstruction of
    election officer) or knowingly contravenes paragraph 43(b)
    (impersonation of election officer); or

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} being a former election officer, wilfully
    contravenes paragraph 43(c) (failure to return election documents
    and election materials).

#### [Offences under Part 11.1 (Prohibitions in relation to Voting)]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1133927 .Subheading}

conviction

**[[491.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-491.1 .sectionLabel}** Every person is

procedure

- **[[491.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-491.2
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every person is guilty of an offence
  who

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} being the Chief Electoral Officer, knowingly
    contravenes section 281.1 (voting by Chief Electoral Officer);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} contravenes section 281.2 (inducing or attempting

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} contravenes paragraph 281.4(b) (inducing or
    attempting to induce a person who is not ordinarily resident in
    electoral district to vote);

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} knowingly contravenes subsection 281.5(1) or (2)
    (voting more than once);

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} knowingly contravenes subsection 281.6(1) (failure
    to maintain secrecy);

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} contravenes subsection 281.6(5) (secrecy ---
    counting of the votes);

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} knowingly contravenes any of paragraphs
    281.7(1)(a), (b) and (d) to (i) (ballots);

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} being an election officer, contravenes paragraph
    281.7(2)(a) or (b) (ballots --- election officer);

  - [(l)]{.lawlabel} being a unit election officer, contravenes
    subsection 281.7(3) (special ballots --- unit election officer);

  - [(m)]{.lawlabel} contravenes subsection 282(2) (person who assists
    elector --- secrecy);

  - [(n)]{.lawlabel} knowingly contravenes section 282.2 (influencing
    electors);

  - [(o)]{.lawlabel} being an election officer, unit election officer or
    member of the staff of a returning officer, knowingly contravenes
    section 282.3 (influencing electors);

  - [(p)]{.lawlabel} contravenes subsection 282.4(1) (undue influence by
    foreigners);

  - [(q)]{.lawlabel} knowingly contravenes subsection 282.4(4)
    (collusion);

  - [(r)]{.lawlabel} knowingly contravenes subsection 282.4(5) (selling
    advertising space);

  - [(s)]{.lawlabel} knowingly contravenes section 282.6 (preventing
    elector from voting);

  - [(t)]{.lawlabel} knowingly contravenes subsection 282.7(1) (offering
    bribe);

  - [(u)]{.lawlabel} knowingly contravenes subsection 282.7(2)
    (accepting bribe); or

  - [(v)]{.lawlabel} knowingly contravenes paragraph 282.8(a) or (b)
    (intimidation, etc.).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Offence requiring intent --- dual
  procedure

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Every entity is guilty of an offence that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} contravenes subsection 282.4(1) (undue influence by
    foreigners);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} knowingly contravenes subsection 282.4(4)
    (collusion); or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} knowingly contravenes subsection 282.4(5) (selling

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Strict liability offences --- summary
conviction

- **[[495]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-495
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every person is guilty of an offence

    acting on behalf of a candidate or registered party, contravenes

    candidate or third party that is required to register under
    subsection 349.6(1) or 353(1), contravenes section 325.2 (failure to
    provide information about self);

    provide election survey information) or (2.1) (failure to ensure

    election survey results) or, being a sponsor of an election survey,

    not based on recognized statistical methods).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Offences requiring intent --- summary

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Every person is guilty of an offence who,

    advertising posters on residential premises); or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} contravenes section 325 (removal of election
    advertising).

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2018, c. 31, s. 333\]]{.Repealed}

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Offences requiring intent --- fine
  only, summary conviction

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Every person is guilty of an offence who

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} being the owner or operator of an online platform,
    knowingly contravenes subsection 325.1(2) or (4) (failure to publish

    messages for required publication period) or subsection 325.1(5)
    (failure to keep information for required period);

    (failure to provide election survey information) or (2.1) (failure

    transmission of election survey results) or, being a sponsor of an
    election survey, knowingly contravenes subsection 326(3) (failure to
    ensure report on election survey results is published);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} wilfully contravenes section 327 (failure to
    indicate survey not based on recognized statistical methods);

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} wilfully contravenes subsection 328(2)

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2014, c. 12, s. 95\]]{.Repealed}

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} wilfully contravenes subsection 330(1) or (2)

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} being a broadcaster, wilfully contravenes
    subsection 335(1) or, being a network operator, wilfully contravenes

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} being a broadcaster, wilfully contravenes
    subsection 339(3) (failure to make additional broadcasting time
    available) or 339(4) (failure to adjust broadcasting time) or, being
    a network operator, wilfully contravenes subsection 345(1) (failure

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} wilfully contravenes section 348 (failure to charge
    lowest rate for broadcasting time or advertising space);

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} being a broadcaster or a network operator, fails to
    comply with an allocation of or entitlement to broadcasting time

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} being a broadcaster or a network operator, makes

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} Every person is guilty of an offence who

##### [Offences under Division 1 of Part 17 (Partisan Activities, Partisan Advertising and Election Surveys During Pre-election Period)]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1134007 .Subheading}

conviction

- **[[495.3]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-495.3
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every person is guilty of an offence
  who, being a third party, contravenes

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} any of subsections 349.1(1) to (3) (exceeding
    pre-election period expenses limits);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} section 349.4 (foreign third party incurring
    pre-election period expenses);

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} section 349.5 (failure to identify self in
    advertising);

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} subsection 349.6(1) (failure to register);

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} section 349.7 (failure to appoint financial agent)
    or subsection 349.8(1) (failure to appoint auditor);

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} subsection 349.91(1) or 349.92(1) (failure to file
    interim third-party expenses return) or 349.91(10) (failure to
    provide documents evidencing expenses on request);

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} paragraph 349.93(b) (filing interim third-party
    expenses return that is substantially incomplete); or

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} being a third party, knowingly contravenes any of

    circumventing pre-election period expenses limits);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} being a third party or registered party, knowingly

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} being a third party or potential candidate,

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} being a third party or official agent of a
    potential candidate, knowingly contravenes subsection 349.3(3)

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} being a third party, knowingly contravenes section
    349.4 (foreign third party incurring pre-election period expenses);

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} being a third party, knowingly contravenes
    subsection 349.6(1) (failure to register);

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} knowingly contravenes subsection 349.7(2) or
    349.8(3) (ineligible person acting as financial agent or auditor);

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} being a third party, knowingly contravenes
    subsection 349.91(1) or 349.92(1) (failure to file interim
    third-party expenses return); or

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} being a third party, contravenes paragraph
    349.93(a) or knowingly contravenes paragraph 349.93(b) (filing
    interim third-party expenses return that contains false or
    misleading information or one that is incomplete).

- **[[497]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-497
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every person is guilty of an offence

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Offences requiring intent --- dual

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Every person is guilty of an offence who

    or pay amount of contribution);

  - [(n)]{.lawlabel} being a person or entity, knowingly contravenes
    subsection 373(1) or (2) (making a loan, guaranteeing a loan or
    borrowing money); or

  - [(o)]{.lawlabel} being an individual, knowingly contravenes section
    374 (making indirect loans).

##### [Offences under Division 1.1 of Part 18 (Regulated Fundraising Events)]{.HTitleText4} {#h-210286 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Strict liability offences --- summary
conviction

**[[497.01]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-497.01 .sectionLabel}** Every person is
guilty of an offence who

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} being a registered party, contravenes subsection
  384.2(1) or (4) (failure to publish information about regulated
  fundraising event);

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} being a person or entity, contravenes subsection
  384.2(3) (failure to provide information about regulated fundraising
  event);

- [(b.1)]{.lawlabel} being a registered party, contravenes subsection
  384.2(4.1) (failure to notify Chief Electoral Officer of regulated
  fundraising event);

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} being a registered party, contravenes subsection
  384.2(5) or (7) (failure to replace old information about regulated
  fundraising event on its Internet site);

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} being a person or entity, contravenes subsection
  384.2(6) (failure to provide new information about regulated
  fundraising event);

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} being a chief agent, contravenes subsection
  384.3(1), (6) or (6.1) (failure to provide report on regulated
  fundraising event);

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} being a chief agent, contravenes subsection 384.3(3)
  (including prohibited name or address in report on regulated
  fundraising event);

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} being a person or entity, contravenes subsection
  384.3(4), (4.1), (9) or (9.1) (failure to provide information about
  regulated fundraising event);

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} being a person or entity, contravenes subsection
  384.3(5) or (10) (including prohibited name or address in information
  about regulated fundraising event);

- [(i)]{.lawlabel} being a chief agent, contravenes subsection 384.3(8)
  or (8.1) (failure to provide report on all regulated fundraising
  events);

- [(j)]{.lawlabel} being a chief agent, contravenes subsection 384.3(12)
  (including prohibited name or address in report on all regulated
  fundraising events);

- [(k)]{.lawlabel} being the chief agent of a registered party, the
  financial agent of a registered association, the official agent of a
  candidate or the financial agent of a nomination contestant or
  leadership contestant, contravenes section 384.4 (failure to return or
  pay amount of contribution); or

- [(l)]{.lawlabel} being a chief agent or the leader of a registered
  party, contravenes subsection 384.7(3) (failure to provide corrected
  or revised report within 30-day period or any extension of that
  period).

- 2018, c. 20, s. 9
